theses.name: Pony AI Inc.
theses.one_liner: Pony AI trades at 24.7x TTM sales on a business its own materials describe as 20-30% unit gross margin, with 2025 FCF of -1,457m RMB funded by 65.3% YoY share growth.
theses.thesis: The market is underwriting a robotaxi fleet land-grab, paying 24.7x TTM sales and 22.4x EV/sales (mcap 3.10bn USD, EV 2.81bn USD) for a business whose September 2026 investor transcript puts per-vehicle daily net revenue at 320-340 RMB against operating cost of 250 RMB or less and a 20-30% unit gross margin. The cost of that land-grab is already visible: operating cash outflow widened from 631m RMB in 2024 to 1,157m RMB in 2025 and 1,418m RMB TTM, FCF was -1,725m RMB (-243m USD) TTM, and the share count grew 65.3% YoY to fund it. The gap closes only if fleet scaling converts into per-vehicle economics before the cash pile (1.39bn USD at Q2 2026) and the equity market's appetite for a 2.90x-revenue operating loss run out; the Q3 2026 print and the year-end 3,500-vehicle target are the first checkpoints.
bear_points: TTM revenue 869m RMB against a net loss of 1,028m RMB, operating cash outflow of 1,418m RMB and FCF of -1,725m RMB (-243m USD); the operating margin is -289.8% (TTM 4Q basis).
Burn is worsening while revenue grows: operating cash outflow rose from 631m RMB (FY2024) to 1,157m RMB (FY2025) to 1,418m RMB (TTM), and capex rose from 83m to 307m RMB over the same span.
The funding is shareholder equity: share count +65.3% YoY, the screen's 'heavy dilution' flag, at 24.7x TTM sales and 22.4x EV/sales.

Company-disclosed unit economics are thin: 320-340 RMB daily net revenue per vehicle, operating cost of 250 RMB or less, 20-30% gross margin, and 125 RMB/day of depreciation over six years (国信证券 2026-09-07 transcript). That is roughly 70-90 RMB of daily gross profit per car against a 3.10bn USD market cap.
The tape is broken independently of the story: -65.4% over 12 months, -50.9% YTD, -13.5% in the last month, with the sell-side targets (UBS Buy 20, Citi Buy 22.7) sitting roughly 3x the 7.26 close.
risks_to_short: All 11 sell-side documents in the bundle are constructive, and their targets are not close to spot: UBS Buy with a 20 target (2026-09-02), Citi Buy with 22.7 (2026-08-26, price then 7.54). A single Uber Europe deployment headline can re-rate a 3.10bn USD market cap violently.

Balance-sheet cushion: 1.39bn USD of cash and equivalents at Q2 2026 (国盛证券 and 光大证券, both 2026-08-21) against -243m USD TTM FCF is several years of runway, so there is no near-term funding cliff to force the story.

Segment growth is real, not narrative: Q2 2026 robotaxi service revenue +691.2% YoY to 12.07m USD and total revenue +68.8% to 36.2m USD (中信建投 2026-08-20). The live X position is not a short at all but a consolidation long (@Jason, 2026-09-22, buying 10k shares at 7.15), with the rebuttal being that nobody has named an acquirer (@NielsPluijmen reply).

Squeeze mechanic: 23.17m shares short is 4.86% of shares outstanding (about 8.4% of the 277.6m float) on a 29.2m USD ADT, so covering is cheap, and the stock is a plausible strategic-bid target rather than a solvency case.
catalysts: Q3 2026 results, and the year-end 2026 fleet target of 3,500 robotaxis (国盛证券 2026-08-21; UBS 2026-09-02).
Uber Europe deployment: 2,000+ robotaxis across five European cities with over 4,000 vehicles under negotiation (中信建投 2026-08-20; 招商证券 2026-09-01).
Robotaxi bill-of-materials guided down from 270k RMB to 230k RMB next year (UBS 2026-09-02) - the unit-economics proof point.
Any further equity issuance, given the 65.3% YoY share-count growth already booked and a burn the P&L does not fund.

x_sentiment.lean: No short thesis on X; the only live position is a small long betting Pony and WeRide get acquired.
x_sentiment.notes: The ev1 sweep states PONY density is sparse and that keyword searches for short/bear/overvalued returned no bear posts, with semantic search polluted by crypto PONS. What exists is product promo, one consolidation long (@Jason, 2026-09-22) and a reply questioning who would actually buy Pony or WeRide. The X read is thin and should not be used as confirmation.

sellside.consensus: 11 documents in the bundle and none of them bearish; targets cluster at 20-22.7 USD against a 7.26 close, and the tone is entirely about fleet expansion, Uber Europe and cost-down rather than unit profitability.

theses.name: WeRide Inc. Class A
theses.one_liner: WeRide burned 1,285m RMB of operating cash flow in FY2025 on 666m RMB of revenue and is funding the gap with a 19.2% YoY share increase, while Q2 growth came from ADAS kits.
theses.thesis: The market is pricing WeRide as a scaled L4 robotaxi platform at 16.6x TTM sales (mcap 1.97bn USD, EV 1.06bn USD), but the cash flow says the platform does not fund itself: FY2025 operating cash outflow was 1,285m RMB against 666m RMB of revenue, or 1.93x revenue, versus a 600m RMB outflow in FY2024, and Citi models roughly 2.0bn RMB of operating cash burn for 2026 (2026-08-24) against 5.37bn RMB of cash at Q2. The Q2 2026 revenue beat is also mix, not robotaxi: L2++/L3 solution revenue grew about 2,594% on roughly 30k units delivered, which is kit volume rather than the L4 fleet economics the multiple is meant to capitalise. The share count is up 19.2% YoY to bridge the gap, and the bundle carries no capex or FCF line for the company at all - the short is that both the cash-flow disclosure and the revenue mix undercut the platform multiple.
bear_points: FY2025 operating cash outflow of 1,285m RMB on 666m RMB of revenue (1.93x revenue), versus a 600m RMB outflow in FY2024; TTM net loss is 1,642m RMB with a net margin of -199.2%.

Citi's own model (2026-08-24) assumes roughly 2.0bn RMB of 2026 operating cash burn against 5.37bn RMB of cash and equivalents at Q2 2026 (华鑫证券 2026-09-07) - about two and a half years at that rate, and the bundle has no capex or FCF figure to size the true outflow.

Growth is coming from low-content L2++/L3 ADAS kit deliveries, not robotaxi: Q2 2026 revenue of 231m RMB (+82.2% YoY, +103.1% QoQ) was led by roughly 30k L2++ units with revenue up about 2,594% (中信建投 2026-09-18; 国盛证券 2026-08-16), while the L4 fleet was 3,400 vehicles with just over 1,800 robotaxis.
Dilution is the funding mechanism: share count +19.2% YoY, against a 16.6x TTM sales and 8.9x EV/sales multiple for a business with a -199.2% net margin.
The screen's own read is a broken tape with a weak business: score_thesis 87.1 and weakness 88.1, on a -49.6% 12-month and -32.9% YTD return, and T2 tradable rather than T1 liquid.
risks_to_short: Every one of the 11 sell-side documents is constructive and the targets are far above the 5.85 close: Morgan Stanley Overweight 12 (2026-09-10), UBS Buy 12 (2026-09-02), Citi Buy/high risk 15.3 (2026-08-24, price then 6.45), Goldman Buy with a 54.72 HKD target (2026-09-03, price then 14.93 HKD). Any of those is a violent re-rate trigger.

Net cash is substantial: mcap 1.97bn USD against an EV of 1.06bn USD implies roughly 0.9bn USD of net cash, and 华鑫证券 (2026-09-07) puts cash and equivalents at 5.37bn RMB - enough to fund several years of the current burn without an emergency raise.

Takeout and consolidation optionality is the live X thesis: @Jason (2026-09-22) is long 15k shares at 5.97 precisely because Tesla/Waymo/Uber progress makes these names acquisition candidates, and management is signing national permits (Spain L4 passenger licence, 13 countries, 60+ cities).

The L2++ kit business could prove to be the point rather than the problem: over 30 vehicle models have production nominations for the WRD 3.0 solution (东吴证券 2026-08-17), and gross margin rose to 37.5% (+9.4 points YoY) with overseas revenue 34.5% of the total - if kit volume repeats, the mix concern dies.
catalysts: Q3 2026 results and the year-end 2026 target of over 2,600 robotaxis (Goldman Sachs 2026-09-03; UBS 2026-09-02).
Madrid, Zurich and Denmark commercial robotaxi launches, and the Singapore/Hong Kong right-hand-drive deployments (国信证券 2026-08-20; 国盛证券 2026-08-16).
Management's stated path to 10x fleet growth over three years and a 2027 new SUV that cuts BOM to about 30k USD per vehicle (UBS 2026-09-02) - a financing requirement as much as a cost milestone.
Any equity raise or capital-markets day, given the 19.2% YoY share growth and the 2.0bn RMB modelled 2026 cash burn.

x_sentiment.lean: Company promo and a bull case dominate; the only bear-adjacent line is a passing cash-burn remark.
x_sentiment.notes: The ev1 sweep flags WRD as sparse with no dedicated short thesis found; the only cash-burn mention is a one-liner (@93SamLFC, 2026-09-10), against a growth-at-a-discount bull model (@BourbonCap, 2026-09-19) and heavy official promo (@WeRide_ai livestreams). Density is thin and the chatter is issuer-influenced, so the X read is not independent confirmation.

sellside.consensus: 11 documents, all constructive, with a very wide target dispersion from 12 USD (Morgan Stanley, UBS) to a 54.72 HKD Goldman target - the disagreement is about how much the platform is worth, not whether the cash burn is a problem.

theses.name: VNET Group, Inc.
theses.one_liner: VNET spent 7,661m RMB of capex on 1,727m RMB of operating cash flow in the TTM, covering the 5,934m RMB FCF gap with a 105.1% YoY share increase and net debt.
theses.thesis: The market is buying the CATL-linked strategic stake and an AI data-centre order book, but VNET's capital intensity has outrun its cash generation: TTM capex of 7,661m RMB is 71.8% of revenue against 1,727m RMB of operating cash flow, leaving FCF of -5,934m RMB (-835m USD) and a TTM net loss of 2,374m RMB. The gap is being closed with equity - share count is up 105.1% YoY, the screen's 'heavy dilution' flag - and with debt, since the EV of 4.84bn USD sits 2.06bn USD above the 2.77bn USD market cap. The tell is that the sell-side has been cutting targets while keeping Buy ratings (Citi 16.4 to 11.4, Morgan Stanley 16 to 14, Nomura 13 to 11.3), which says the market is repricing the financing plan rather than the demand; the bear case breaks if the CATL affiliate's power and storage synergies actually lower the cost of that build.
bear_points: TTM capex 7,661m RMB versus operating cash flow 1,727m RMB leaves FCF of -5,934m RMB (-835m USD) and a net loss of 2,374m RMB; capex intensity is 71.8% of revenue.
The funding is shareholders: share count +105.1% YoY, flagged by the screen as heavy dilution alongside 'cash burner', with FCF yield of -30.1%.

The leverage is already there: mcap 2.77bn USD against an EV of 4.84bn USD implies roughly 2.06bn USD of net debt, on a company whose 2025 operating cash flow (1,867m RMB) fell 8.2% while capex rose 53% to 7,661m RMB.
The loss line is volatile in the wrong direction: Q1 2026 net margin was -82.8% and Q2 2026 was -5.2%, so the reported profitability is not stabilising even as revenue grew 15.0% TTM.

Governance is a live filing-level argument, not a vibe: the FY25 20-F discloses that some lessors lack ownership certificates, including one data-centre building without a property ownership certificate (X, @LivyResearch, 2026-09-04, quoting the filing), with the pushback that the disclosed item is a single building (@AIQuanting) - i.e. the risk is real but unsized.
risks_to_short: The strategic backer removes the dilution catalyst: the CATL affiliate PJ Millennium closed its purchase of 38.1% for about 942m USD earlier than the market's Q4 2026 expectation (Citi 2026-09-21), and management told Goldman Sachs (2026-09-03) there is no equity financing planned this year with net debt/EBITDA to stay below 6x.

Borrow is crowded and the float is small: 39.56m shares short against a 64.06m ADR float (6.09% of shares outstanding but roughly 62% of the ADR float) means a squeeze on any positive order or financing headline, with an ADT of 31.8m USD.

Demand is visible and third-party: Q2 2026 added 347MW of new orders for 862MW year-to-date with wholesale capacity above 1GW (+49.4% YoY), and Citi (2026-09-03) treats a ByteDance 5-6GW Inner Mongolia AI data-centre plan as upside to VNET's 2GW 2026-2028 target.

The re-rating has already partly happened: X notes a 150% move in seven weeks and the first close above the 200-day moving average since 2021 (@perseveretrader, 2026-09-20), while all 12 sell-side documents remain Buy or Overweight with targets 11.3-16 against a 6.92 close.
catalysts: Completion of the remaining PJ Millennium/CATL-affiliate stake tranches and any commercial agreement with CATL on power and storage (Citi 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-21; Goldman Sachs 2026-09-03).
2026 delivery guidance of 450-500MW of capacity and the 1,000-1,100MW wholesale order target for the year (Goldman Sachs 2026-09-03).
Q3 2026 results, where Morgan Stanley (2026-08-19) expects EBITDA growth to accelerate from Q3 onward - the single biggest risk to the short.
Chip supply availability through H2 2026, which both Goldman Sachs (2026-08-24) and the company identify as the gate on wholesale move-in and therefore on revenue conversion.

x_sentiment.lean: Event-driven and mostly constructive on the CATL-linked stake, with one filing-based bear note and technical dip-buying.
x_sentiment.notes: The internet2 sweep calls VNET mixed rather than a short pile-on: the dominant content is the PJ Millennium 38.1% block close and TA bulls after a large run, with the one genuinely filing-grounded bear being the lease-title post (@LivyResearch, 2026-09-04) and an immediate size challenge to it (@AIQuanting). Engagement on the real notes is tiny (0-13 likes) against a 69-like promotional recap, and the sweep found no short-interest or days-to-cover data for the name.

sellside.consensus: 12 documents, uniformly Buy or Overweight on AI data-centre demand and the CATL partnership, but the targets have been cut repeatedly into the print (Citi 16.4 to 11.4, Morgan Stanley 16 to 14, Nomura 13 to 11.3) and even the reduced targets sit 60-100% above the 6.92 close - the Street is debating financing, not demand.

theses.name: Zai Lab Ltd.
theses.one_liner: Zai Lab's commercial base is shrinking (-3.4% TTM revenue, -6.25% H1 product revenue) while the equity prices a 2027-2028 pipeline the P&L does not fund.
theses.thesis: The market is paying 6.8x TTM sales (mcap 3.06bn USD) for a company whose revenue is going backwards: TTM revenue is -3.4% YoY, H1 2026 product revenue fell 6.25% to 201.3m USD, Q2 product revenue fell 3.06% YoY, and gross margin has slipped from 62.9% in 2024 to 58.5% in 2025. Every sell-side document in the bundle rests on the same forward bridge - a 2027 commercial return to growth and ZL-1310/Zoci plus ZL-1503 data - which is exactly what brokers say when the current franchise has stopped compounding; 太平洋 (2026-08-14) models 2026 revenue at -10%. The funding gap is real but slow: TTM FCF of -1,134m RMB (-145m USD) against the screen's 4.2-year runway and net cash of only 12.2% of market cap means the pipeline has to work before the balance sheet forces the issue.
bear_points: Revenue is contracting: TTM revenue -3.4% YoY to 3,511m RMB, H1 2026 total revenue 205.9m USD (-5% YoY), Q2 product revenue 105.8m USD (-3.06% YoY), with 太平洋 modelling 2026 revenue at 416m USD, or -10% YoY (2026-08-14).

Gross margin is eroding while the loss persists: 62.94% (2024) to 58.47% (2025), with a TTM operating margin of -58.7% and net margin of -41.9%; Q2 2026 net income was -50.8m USD on revenue of 106.3m USD.
Costs are rising faster than the top line: Q2 2026 R&D 61.8m USD (+22% YoY) and SG&A 72.9m USD, producing a 76.5m USD operating loss and 60.4m USD adjusted operating loss (东吴证券 2026-08-07).

Cash conversion is negative and the cushion is modest: TTM FCF -1,134m RMB (-145m USD) against 717.5m USD of cash and equivalents (2026-06-30) - the screen's runway of 4.2 years and net cash of just 12.2% of market cap.

The two core products are the problem: 则乐 (ZEJULA) and 艾加莫德 (VYVGART) were described as under pressure with Q2 revenue of 32.1m USD and 23.9m USD respectively, i.e. the entire beat rests on sequential recovery in franchises that just decelerated (国泰海通 2026-08-24; 兴业证券 2026-08-17).
risks_to_short: The whole Street is long the pipeline and the targets are far above spot: Citi Buy with the target raised 1 USD to 45 (2026-08-06, price then 18.37), J.P.Morgan Overweight moving to a December 2027 target of 36 (2026-08-26), UBS Buy 27 HKD (2026-08-07), Morgan Stanley Overweight 19 HKD (2026-08-10).

Binaries are within months, not years: Zoci 1L ES-SCLC data at ESMO in October 2026, ZL-1503 first-in-human data in H2 2026, and a US accelerated filing modelled for end-2027 with approval in 2028 (中信建投 2026-08-13; 中金公司 2026-08-07). A positive read breaks the short outright.

The balance sheet does not force anything: net cash of 12.2% of market cap with a 4.2-year screen runway and only 2.2% YoY dilution means there is no financing cliff to accelerate the thesis - this is a slow short, not an event short.

Borrow is not obviously the constraint but the float is small: 8.02m shares short on a 97.1m share float (7.33% of shares outstanding) with a 26.9m USD ADT, so positioning is already established and further crowding is limited.
catalysts: Zoci (ZL-1310, DLL3 ADC) first-line ES-SCLC combination data at ESMO, October 2026 (中信建投 2026-08-13; 国泰海通 2026-08-24).
ZL-1503 first-in-human SAD data in H2 2026 (国泰海通 2026-08-24; UBS 2026-08-07).
Q3 2026 results - the test of whether the Q2 sequential product recovery (+11.0% QoQ) held.
US regulatory milestones: a second Fast Track for Zoci and EMA orphan designation already granted; accelerated US filing modelled for end-2027 (国泰海通 2026-08-24; 中金公司 2026-08-07).

x_sentiment.lean: No read - there is no ZLAB bear case on X at all; the name only appears as options flow and bot dip-buy copy.
x_sentiment.notes: The health1 sweep states plainly that ZLAB short hits are false positives: two near-identical bots used the phrase short-term pain, and the only real market post is an options risk reversal (sell 22.5P / sell 40C / buy 30C) that is not a directional short (@Yam_Trades, 2026-08-26). The genuinely bearish content in that batch belongs to LEGN, HCM, ADAG and BNR, not ZLAB. Density is thin and no independent X bear exists for this ticker.

sellside.consensus: 12 documents and effectively no bear: every house is Buy or Overweight and the debate is about target level, not direction. Two houses have moved to 2027 targets (J.P.Morgan to 36, Citi to 45) on the pipeline bridge, while the Chinese-language notes describe a stabilising rather than growing commercial base.

theses.name: EHang Holdings Ltd. Class A
theses.one_liner: EHang pulled its 2026 revenue guidance after Q2 revenue fell 30.7% YoY, while FY2025 FCF swung to -323m RMB and the share count rose 42.9% YoY.
theses.thesis: The market still ascribes a commercialisation premium to the only company with a manned eVTOL operating certificate, but the certification has not become revenue: Q2 2026 revenue fell 30.7% YoY to 77.7m RMB with 36 aircraft delivered and a -164.0% net margin, and the company withdrew its 6bn RMB 2026 revenue guidance (previously +20% YoY). The cost base did not withdraw with it - FY2025 operating cash flow swung from +160m RMB in 2024 to -175m RMB, capex rose to 148m RMB (34.0% of revenue) and FCF went from +121m RMB to -323m RMB, while the share count is up 42.9% YoY. J.P.Morgan's downgrade to Underweight (2026-07-03) put its own 2026-2028 revenue forecasts 55-75% below consensus at a 4.4 target and cut again to 3.9 on 2026-08-25; the short is that the regulatory clock, not the demand curve, now sets the revenue line.
bear_points: Revenue is collapsing against a guidance withdrawal: Q2 2026 revenue 77.7m RMB, -30.7% YoY, with Q1 2026 at 25.6m RMB and a -490.9% net margin; the 6bn RMB 2026 revenue guidance was pulled (J.P.Morgan 2026-08-25; UBS 2026-08-25; Deutsche Bank 2026-08-27).

Cash generation has inverted: FY2024 operating cash flow +160m RMB and FCF +121m RMB became FY2025 operating cash flow -175m RMB and FCF -323m RMB (-45m USD), with capex up to 148m RMB, or 34.0% of revenue.

The loss is not narrowing: TTM net loss 263m RMB on a -61.4% net margin and TTM FCF yield of -12.7%, at 5.7x TTM sales and 5.9x EV/sales on a 359m USD market cap, with EV above market cap (368m USD) so there is net debt rather than net cash support.

Shareholders are absorbing the gap: share count +42.9% YoY, the screen's 'heavy dilution' flag, alongside 'cash burner', 'revenue collapse' and 'broken tape' - the stock is -74.4% over 12 months, -66.0% YTD and -18.6% in the last month.

The regulatory mechanism is named and dated: after a June 2026 general-aviation accident, domestic low-altitude regulation tightened and manned commercialisation timing became uncertain (J.P.Morgan 2026-08-25; Morgan Stanley 2026-08-25), with the CCAR-120 transition requiring general-aviation operators to complete re-licensing by end-2027 (金元证券 2026-08-23).
risks_to_short: Borrow is the binding constraint, not the story: the screen scores borrow at 42 versus 100 for weakness and valuation, the tier is T3 restricted, ADT is only 3.37m USD on a 359m USD market cap, and there is no float data - this is hard if not impossible to size properly.

The squeeze setup is explicit and sourced: short interest is 10.19% of shares outstanding per the screen, while an X post claims roughly 18% of float and 16.3 days to cover (@keeithsimple31, 2026-09-16, figures not independently verified here) and another reply warns it is getting dangerous for shorts (@MasteriasTrades, 2026-09-17). Any certification headline gaps this.

Two houses still defend it on the franchise rather than the print: Morgan Stanley remains Overweight with a 7.7 target (2026-08-25), arguing the certification premium has unwound while the franchise has not, and UBS is Neutral at 11.1 (2026-08-25).

Live catalysts with real optionality: 9.29bn RMB of cash and short-term investments at Q2 2026 (Deutsche Bank 2026-08-27), a Thai commercial operating licence targeted by end-2026 (Morgan Stanley 2026-08-25), operations already in 23 countries, and a pivot to non-passenger and overseas revenue that could restart deliveries without the China passenger approval.
catalysts: Thai commercial operating licence targeted by end-2026 (Morgan Stanley 2026-08-25).
Q3 2026 results - the first print after the guidance withdrawal, with the 36-unit Q2 delivery run rate as the base.

CCAR-120 re-licensing deadline of end-2027 for general-aviation operators, plus the 30m RMB paid-in capital and two-aircraft requirements for aerial-tour operators (金元证券 2026-08-23) - the regulatory gate on domestic manned operations.
Sell-side estimate revisions: J.P.Morgan's 2026-2028 revenue forecasts already sit 55-75% below consensus (2026-07-03), so consensus itself is the catalyst.

x_sentiment.lean: The only genuine bear cluster in its batch - certification without commercial launch, guidance pulled, Street cutting - with a squeeze worry layered on top.
x_sentiment.notes: The ev2 sweep says EH is the only name in its batch with a real bear cluster: the company's sandbox and permit posts draw replies that certificates without commercial launch are meaningless and that the share price has dumped, a wire recap notes a 9.9% plunge on the earnings miss and pulled outlook, and posts track the Morgan Stanley and Goldman cuts. Engagement is still small (tens of likes, not thousands) and the issuer account is the highest-volume voice, so the read is mixed rather than a crowd.

sellside.consensus: 12 documents with genuine rating divergence rather than consensus: J.P.Morgan is Underweight (cut to 3.9 on 2026-08-25 after a 2026-07-03 downgrade), Goldman Sachs cut to Neutral (6.9 as of 2026-09-10, from Buy at 16.9 on 2026-07-14), UBS is Neutral at 11.1, while Morgan Stanley holds Overweight at 7.7 and Deutsche Bank is at 9. The common fact in every note is the withdrawn 2026 guidance.

theses.name: Full Truck Alliance Co. Ltd.
theses.one_liner: Full Truck Alliance still trades at 4.8x sales and 14.4x earnings while TTM revenue growth has fallen to 5.2% and Q3 revenue is guided roughly flat - a trading short, not a solvency one.
theses.thesis: The market is paying a growth multiple (PS 4.8, PE 14.4, EV/sales 4.3) for a business that has stopped growing: TTM revenue is +5.2% YoY, Q2 2026 net revenue grew 4.4% to 3,382m RMB, the company cut full-year order growth guidance to 12-15% and guided Q3 2026 revenue to a roughly flat 3,370m RMB midpoint. Underneath the headline, the fastest-growing line is transaction services (+33.1% to 1,766m RMB, now 52.2% of net revenue) while brokerage and financial services revenue fell 15% and 25% YoY, so the mix shift is cannibalisation of the old take, and the medium-term commission target is 3% against 2% today. The screen also flags share count +70.6% YoY, a number this bundle cannot explain and which needs verification - if it is real, the per-share case is materially worse than the P&L suggests.
bear_points: Deceleration is now in the guidance, not the forecast: TTM revenue +5.2% YoY, Q2 2026 net revenue 3,382m RMB (+4.4%), full-year order growth guidance cut to 12-15%, and Q3 2026 revenue guided to a roughly flat 3,370m RMB midpoint (华泰证券 2026-08-20).
The growth line is buying the decline: transaction services revenue +33.1% to 1,766m RMB (52.2% of net revenue) while brokerage and financial services revenue fell 15% and 25% YoY (天风证券 2026-09-17).
Take rate has a ceiling well below the pitch: realised commission is 2% against a 3% medium-term target (Morgan Stanley 2026-08-21; Goldman Sachs 2026-08-20), which caps the mix-shift contribution.

The screen flags share count +70.6% YoY and no float data at all, so position sizing is blind and the dilution flag is unverified by the bundle - both belong in the bear case as open items, not as proven facts.
Consensus numbers are already coming down - 天风证券 cut its 2026 net profit forecast to 4.5bn RMB while keeping Buy (2026-09-17) - and the stock is -37.9% over 12 months and -22.4% YTD.
risks_to_short: There is no cash-burn leg to lean on: TTM FCF is +4,374m RMB (+616m USD) on a 33.1% net margin, with Q2 2026 operating cash flow of 2,144m RMB and Q1 2026 of 1,555m RMB, and the company is debt-light on a 7.0% screen FCF yield.

All 12 sell-side documents are Buy with targets between 11 and 15 against the 8.34 close, including post-print notes from HSBC (Buy 15, 2026-08-20), UBS (Buy 13.36, 2026-08-19), Goldman Sachs (Buy 11.7, 2026-08-20) and Citi (Buy/high risk 14, 2026-09-03).

Capital return is a mechanical bid: a 400m USD 2026 shareholder-return commitment with quarterly dividends already being paid - 87.5m USD in the quarter (UBS 2026-08-19; Citi 2026-09-03) - and Morgan Stanley (2026-08-21) expects dividends to rise in 2027.

The bear inputs on X are a value long, not a short: @smartkarma (2026-09-22) pitches 12x FY0 earnings, a 4% yield and what it calls 3.5bn USD of net cash (the screen's EV of 7.90bn USD against an 8.77bn USD market cap implies far less, so the figure needs checking), and @stock_market001's only caveat is cyclical freight plus regulatory risk.
catalysts: Q3 2026 results and the revenue guide midpoint of roughly 3,370m RMB, plus the Q4 order-growth recovery management has promised to low-to-mid teens (HSBC 2026-08-24).
Any Hong Kong listing (flagged on X as listing optionality, @smartkarma 2026-09-22) - a mechanical supply event as much as a positive.
Exit from own-balance-sheet lending, with Morgan Stanley (2026-08-21) expecting the self-funded credit exposure to reach zero by end-2027, and the associated release of credit provisions.
Verification of the screen's 70.6% YoY share-count increase, which would be the single most important datum for the per-share thesis.

x_sentiment.lean: Value/long - the name is pitched as a cheap cash-generative ADR, not a short.
x_sentiment.notes: The mega3 sweep lists YMM as sparse with thin chatter and a value/long lean; the only substantive post is a Smartkarma pitch on 12x FY0 earnings, a 4% yield and Hong Kong listing optionality (@smartkarma, 2026-09-22), plus a dividend-and-buyback screen mention (@TickerCanvas, 2026-09-16) and one promotional account whose only caveat is cyclical freight and regulatory risk (@stock_market001, 2026-09-11). The batch's real bear content was on ZTO's Alibaba block sale and FUTU's CSRC overhang, not YMM.

sellside.consensus: 12 documents and no bears: every house is Buy or Overweight, but the growth language has shifted to mixed or resilient rather than accelerating, and Nomura titled its note a mixed outlook with guidance cut on orders (2026-08-19/20). Targets sit 26% to 80% above the 8.34 close.

theses.name: Daqo New Energy Corp
theses.one_liner: Daqo burned RMB 1.90bn of operating cash in H1 2026 while selling polysilicon below cash cost, yet trades at a fraction of its USD 1.9bn net cash - a short on liquidation value, not solvency.
theses.thesis: The market believes the anti-involution (反内卷) price-enforcement regime restores positive operating cash flow once polysilicon clears RMB 40/kg - HSBC maintained Buy with PT USD 19 on 2026-09-03 on exactly that arithmetic. H1 2026 says otherwise: Q1 and Q2 2026 operating cash flow was -RMB 1,020m and -RMB 875m, a -RMB 1,896m half against a -RMB 755m TTM figure, on H1 revenue of RMB 611m versus RMB 1,441m a year earlier (-57.6%) and a TTM operating margin of -40.6%. Goldman Sachs cut to Sell with PT USD 10 on 2026-08-25 on execution and rising SG&A, not on price. The gap closes only if enforcement lands and poly prices hold; the offset that caps the short is that the screen's EV of USD 203m against an USD 833m market cap implies the equity is mostly net cash, and J.P.Morgan puts net cash at USD 1.9bn with zero debt.
bear_points: The burn is accelerating, not narrowing: H1 2026 operating cash outflow of RMB 1,896m (Q1 -RMB 1,020m, Q2 -RMB 875m) against a TTM figure of only -RMB 755m and TTM free cash flow of -RMB 1,966m (-USD 276.8m), a -33.2% FCF yield.
Revenue has collapsed for two years: FY2024 RMB 7,514.9m (-54% versus FY2023), FY2025 RMB 4,668.0m (-37.9%), and Q1 2026 RMB 184.8m versus RMB 900.7m in Q1 2025 (-79.5%).

Selling below cash cost: an X analyst post (@NomisesMedici, 2026-09-16) puts the Q2 ASP at USD 4.04/kg against a cash cost of USD 4.57/kg with Chinese inventories above 540kt. FY2025 gross margin was -20.7% and the TTM operating margin is -40.6%.
Capex has not been cut to match: RMB 1,210.6m TTM, 30.9% of revenue, against a cash flow statement that cannot fund it.
The tape is broken independently of policy: -57.3% over 12 months, -61.4% YTD, -45.0% over six months, and Goldman Sachs downgraded to Sell on 2026-08-25.
risks_to_short: Mechanical floor: the screen's EV of USD 203m against an USD 833m market cap implies roughly USD 630m of net cash, and J.P.Morgan (2026-08-20) puts net cash at USD 1.9bn - above twice the market cap - with zero debt. There is no funding cliff, so nothing forces the equity toward zero.

The sell-side is not on the short's side: J.P.Morgan stayed Overweight with PT USD 22 (2026-08-24) and flags a buyback once operating cash flow turns positive; HSBC is Buy with PT USD 19 (2026-09-03); Citi is Buy high-risk with PT USD 26 (2026-05-13); Nomura carried Buy with PT USD 28.60 (2026-02-27). Goldman's Sell target of USD 10 is only about 16% below the USD 11.91 close.

The swing factor is exogenous policy, not the company: Citi (2026-05-13) expected June 2026 rules to lift poly to RMB 40-45/kg and HSBC says operating cash flow turns positive at RMB 40/kg. A single enforcement announcement re-rates the print.

Borrow is only moderately available (screen borrow score 66.0) with short interest already 11.7% of the 43.18m-share float, and the most notable options print of the window was 5,000 Jan-2027 USD 11 puts SOLD at USD 1.27 (@OptionsHawk, 2026-09-15) - the opposite of a short-entry signature.
catalysts: Q3 2026 results - the first print that tests whether the RMB 40/kg price-enforcement regime actually lands.
Polysilicon anti-involution (反内卷) enforcement on capacity, the June 2026 rules Citi expected and the year-end RMB 40/kg target HSBC and J.P.Morgan both model.
The RMB 6bn AIDC power business, guided to first revenue in 2027 and USD 1bn of revenue by 2030 with 20-25% net margin (J.P.Morgan 2026-08-24, HSBC 2026-09-03).
Resumption of buybacks, which J.P.Morgan (2026-08-24) explicitly ties to positive operating cash flow.

x_sentiment.lean: Glut-bear versus balance-sheet bull; X is split and thin, with no activist short campaign behind the name.
x_sentiment.notes: The energy1 batch sweep names DQ directly and rates its density sparse - a handful of posts - and states explicitly that there is no Hindenburg/Citron-style campaign in the window. The best bear datapoint is an analyst post on the negative cash spread and rising Chinese inventory; the loudest counter is a net-cash and oligopoly bull case. WhatsApp promo accounts also ticker-stuff DQ, which should not be read as flow. The X read is thin and is not confirmation of anything.

sellside.consensus: Twelve documents, and the balance turned in August 2026: Goldman Sachs cut to Sell with PT USD 10 on 2026-08-25 while J.P.Morgan, HSBC, Citi and Nomura stayed constructive with targets of USD 19-28.60. Much of the bear content sits inside the buy notes, which concede weak ASPs and loss-making quarters.

theses.name: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Ltd
theses.one_liner: Baosheng Media is an USD 9.0m micro-cap with USD 0.57m of TTM revenue, a -2,113% net margin, 0.6 years of runway and no analyst coverage - and the trade is a squeeze.
theses.thesis: Baosheng Media has effectively stopped being a business. The bundle reports its financials on a USD basis (fcf_usd is identical to fcf, and the screen divides its USD 8.44m EV by the raw revenue figure), so on that basis TTM revenue is USD 568,993, the net loss is USD 12.0m, the operating margin is -1,799% and the net margin is -2,113%, with revenue falling four years running from USD 2,415,098 (2022) to USD 921,834 (2023) to USD 624,087 (2024) to USD 568,993 (2025) - a -38.2% three-year CAGR. The screen puts runway at 0.6 years and cash at 5.96% of market cap against TTM operating cash outflow of USD 2.26m, so survival requires external capital at an USD 0.2669 share price. There is no analyst coverage at all: the twelve AlphaEngine hits are filings - eight 重大事件报告, two 外国公司注册声明 and a 招股说明书补充 dated between 2026-07-24 and 2026-09-18. What makes this a hard short to hold rather than merely a bad company is the mechanic: X accounts claim zero shares to borrow with a 400-600% cost-to-borrow and 105% of float short (unverified), the float is 1,511,500 shares, and the stock turns over USD 4.61m a day - roughly half its market cap - so the squeeze is the dominant risk. Confidence is low because the thesis rests on the financials plus filings, with no analyst and no researched short content on X.
bear_points: TTM revenue of USD 568,993 against a USD 12.0m net loss; operating margin -1,799% and net margin -2,113%.
Revenue shrank four years in a row: USD 2,415,098 (2022), USD 921,834 (2023), USD 624,087 (2024), USD 568,993 (2025) - a -38.2% three-year CAGR and -8.8% in the latest year.

Runway of 0.6 years with TTM operating cash flow of -USD 2.26m and free cash flow of -USD 2.26m on a USD 8.98m market cap; cash is 5.96% of market cap. The screen flags 'cash burner', 'runway<2y', 'micro-cap' and 'broken tape'.

The dilution and registration machinery is the operating model: twelve bundle documents, all 公告, including two 外国公司注册声明 (2026-09-03 and 2026-09-09) and a 招股说明书补充 (2026-07-24), with no analyst note, rating or target anywhere.
The tape is terminal: -42.0% in the last month, -89.9% over three months, -91.6% over twelve months and -94.8% over three years, on an USD 0.2669 close.
risks_to_short: Borrow is the binding constraint and the screen cannot see it: the flags include 'SI at floor/unknown' with si_ratio 1.0 and 77,229 shares short, 5.1% of the 1,511,500-share float. X accounts claim 0 shares to borrow and a 400-600% cost-to-borrow (@KojiroSasaki, 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-16); those figures are unverified, but the absence of borrow is the reason a short cannot be expressed at size.

The squeeze setup is explicit and organised: a Nasdaq minimum-bid deficiency is being traded as the catalyst rather than the risk - 'they need to get BAOS over USD 1' (@KojiroSasaki, 2026-09-09, 2,191 views) - with @ShortSqueezeFun claiming a desk position of 49,307 shares at USD 0.3191 against '105.7% of float' short (2026-09-11) and @HeartRateTrader posting a '$RETO move' setup with '6m float with 400%+ CTB' (2026-09-15, 6,740 views).

A USD 4.61m ADT on a 1.51m-share float means turnover is roughly ten times the float per session: a reverse split, a compliance-driven bounce or a promotional campaign can move the name hundreds of percent before any fundamental datapoint.

The only short action in the X tape is a day-trade fade - @BVC_bursatil shorted 3,571 shares at USD 0.28 on 2026-09-15 - which tells you the realistic position size for a fundamental book is close to zero.
catalysts: Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance deadline - the deficiency notice is the event X is trading, and failure leads to a delisting determination.
The next 重大事件报告 or 外国公司注册声明, i.e. the financing that the 0.6-year runway requires.
Any reverse split, which would reset the quoted price without changing the business.
A Nasdaq delisting determination if compliance is not achieved.

x_sentiment.lean: Squeeze-long and explicitly anti-short: zero borrow, 400-600% CTB and '105% of float shorted' are traded as reasons to buy, not to sell.
x_sentiment.notes: The small5 batch sweep names BAOS directly. It rates the squeeze and promo chatter strong but the researched bear content sparse, and its own bottom line is that 'density of a researched short thesis: sparse'. Almost all of it is nano-cap momentum promotion (@HeartRateTrader, @ShortSqueezeFun, @SPARTANILLYRIAN ticker-list spam) plus one compliance-and-borrow post; the only bear action is one tiny day-trade fade. Float, short-interest and cost-to-borrow figures conflict across accounts and are not independently verified here.

sellside.consensus: No coverage. The twelve documents in the bundle are all filings (公告) - 重大事件报告, 外国公司注册声明 and a 招股说明书补充 dated 2026-07-24 to 2026-09-18 - with no analyst note, rating, estimate or target. The thesis rests on the financials, the screen and the filings alone.

theses.name: Canaan Inc. Class A
theses.one_liner: Canaan diluted shareholders 207.4% YoY, guided Q3 2026 revenue to USD 11-15m after a USD 32m Q2, took a USD 25.3m inventory write-down and sold its ETH stack at a loss.
theses.thesis: Canaan is a hardware cycle bust being funded by shareholders. The screen's dilution input is 207.4% year over year - the 'heavy dilution' flag - against TTM free cash flow of -RMB 2,074.9m (-USD 292.1m) on an USD 298.5m market cap, a -97.9% FCF yield. The product business broke in Q2 2026: revenue of about USD 32m against the company's own USD 35-45m guide, product revenue down more than 80% YoY, a USD 97.6m net loss versus USD 11.1m a year earlier, a USD 25.3m inventory write-down, and Q3 guidance of USD 11-15m - roughly a third of the Q2 print. The company is now liquidating the treasury it accumulated: it sold its entire 3,952 ETH holding at about USD 2,400 against a roughly USD 4,100 cost. The bull offset is that 1,915.5 BTC remains, and the only active analyst has a USD 2 target on a USD 0.3864 stock.
bear_points: Dilution of 207.4% year over year against TTM free cash flow of -RMB 2,074.9m (-USD 292.1m) on an USD 298.5m market cap: a -97.9% FCF yield funded by issuing equity.

Q2 2026 revenue of about USD 32m missed the company's own USD 35-45m guide; product revenue fell more than 80% YoY; the net loss was USD 97.6m versus USD 11.1m a year earlier; and a USD 25.3m inventory write-down was taken (@BitcoinNewsCom, 2026-09-18; @gulVasikova, 2026-09-18).

Q3 2026 guidance of USD 11-15m is roughly a third of the USD 32m Q2 print and a fraction of the FY2025 run-rate (Q4 2025 alone was RMB 1,379.3m, or about USD 194m at the bundle's 7.10 rate) - this is a cycle break, not a soft quarter.

The bitcoin treasury is being sold at a loss to plug the hole: the entire 3,952 ETH holding went at about USD 2,400 against a roughly USD 4,100 cost, an approximately USD 6.8m realised loss, alongside 54 BTC, with USD 13.9m partly used to repurchase 13.6m ADS (@vishal4c, 2026-09-14).

FY2025 was already loss-making on record revenue: RMB 3,716.2m of revenue (+89% versus FY2024's RMB 1,966.8m) produced a -39.69% net margin, with operating cash outflow of RMB 1,902.6m and TTM operating margin of -21.2%.
risks_to_short: BTIG reiterated Buy on 2026-09-08 while cutting its target to USD 2 from USD 3 - roughly 5x the USD 0.3864 close. The target looks stale against the Q2 print, but it is a live published number and a bounce can be defended with it.

BTC treasury optionality: 1,915.5 BTC was held at Q2 2026 (transcript) and X longs argue the treasury is worth more than half the market cap. A bitcoin rally re-rates every listed miner regardless of profitability, and the stock is already +10.6% in the last month and +11.9% over three months.

Borrow, not the story, is the constraint: tier T3 restricted, screen gate 0.76, 'no float data' flag with a null float and a null beta. 66.5m shares short on an unknown float means both the size available and the squeeze risk are unquantifiable.

It is an USD 298.5m micro-cap on an USD 7.58m ADT; the 12-month return is -46.6% but the last month is +10.6%, so the tape is no longer one-way and the remaining catalyst (gigawatt-scale power capacity by end-2026) is a headline the market can trade.
catalysts: Q3 2026 results against the USD 11-15m revenue guide - the first test of whether the cut is the trough.
Bitcoin and ETH treasury marks: 1,915.5 BTC held at Q2 2026 against the completed ETH liquidation at a realised loss.
Any further equity issuance, with dilution already at 207.4% YoY.
The guided gigawatt-scale power capacity by end-2026 (Q2 2026 transcript), the last piece of the bull narrative.

x_sentiment.lean: The operating bear case is documented and primary; the price debate is 'too cheap versus the BTC treasury', not a short campaign.
x_sentiment.notes: The energy1 batch sweep names CAN directly and rates it mixed, with a real news pulse around the Q2 print. Posts are news recaps (@BitcoinNewsCom, 19 likes) plus one explicit bear-path post setting out the chain from weak miner demand to discounting, inventory losses, cash burn, crypto sales and financing pressure (@gulVasikova). One reply calls it a 'Chinese scam', which is unverified rumour and not evidence. Density is batch-level; two names in that batch (EBON) were effectively empty.

sellside.consensus: Twelve hits but only one active analyst relationship: BTIG carrying Buy with a target cut to USD 2 from USD 3 (2026-09-08) and a stale Rosenblatt note with a USD 5 target dated 2025-05-27. The remaining hits are transcripts. Coverage is thin and the only recent action was a target cut.

theses.name: ATRenew Inc.
theses.one_liner: ATRenew prints a 2% GAAP margin while TTM operating cash flow is -403.5m RMB, FY2025 free cash flow -547.9m RMB and dilution hit 84% YoY - and as a T3 restricted name it is barely borrowable.
theses.thesis: The market is paying 13.8x trailing earnings and 0.26x sales for a 33.4% revenue grower that management says will keep compounding 23-27%. What the screen shows is that the growth consumes cash: FY2025 was the first year operating cash flow went negative (-403.5m RMB) and free cash flow was -547.9m RMB, even as GAAP net income turned positive at 328m RMB. Dilution of 84.4% year-over-year is what funds the 1P-heavy mix. The mechanism is a working-capital treadmill - buying and holding used devices to grow retail revenue - so if device prices or trade-in supply move against the company, the accounting profit does not convert and the equity keeps being issued. Note the short mechanics: RERE carries the 'no float data' and 'T3 restricted' screens with a 90.0 borrow score but only 1.63% short interest, so this is a watchlist name rather than an implementable short.
bear_points: Cash conversion failure: TTM operating cash flow -403.5m RMB and FCF -547.9m RMB (FCF margin -2.28%) on 24,025m RMB TTM revenue, after FY2024 OCF of +651.9m RMB and FCF of +592.1m RMB - the sign flipped as revenue scaled.

Thin margins leave no buffer: TTM net margin 2.01% and FY2025 net margin 1.60% on 20,487m RMB revenue; Q2 2026 GAAP net income was 129m RMB on 6,597m RMB revenue (华泰证券, 2026-08-24) - a 200bp move in realised device prices wipes out the year.

Dilution of 84.36% year-over-year, the largest in the batch, while the company returned only 4.2m USD of buybacks in Q2 2026 (1m ADS) with 35.2m USD of authorisation remaining to June 2027 (中信建投, 2026-08-21).

Guidance decelerated at the Q2 print: Q3 2026 revenue guided to 6.34-6.44bn RMB, +23.1-25.1% YoY (申万宏源, 2026-08-25), versus Q2's 32.4% - and UBS (2026-08-21) had to publish a note titled 'are concerns on guidance overdone?' after the stock fell on it.

Implementation is close to impossible: the screen flags 'no float data' and 'T3 restricted' with a 4.2m USD average daily turnover, and short interest is only 1.63% of shares short - 2.6m shares against a 885m USD market cap.
risks_to_short: UBS initiated at Buy with a 5.50 USD target on 2026-07-22 when the stock was 3.80 USD, modelling 2025-2028 revenue and non-GAAP net profit CAGRs of 23% and 44% - the bull case is explicit that the current multiple is a discount to both history and peers.

Management has committed to returning about 60% of non-GAAP net profit through buybacks and dividends (UBS NDR, 2026-08-31), with the buyback programme extended to June 2027 - that is a real bid under the float of a 885m USD company.

The operating trend is up, not down: Q2 2026 revenue 6.61bn RMB (+32.4%, above the top of guidance), non-GAAP operating profit 206m RMB (+70.1%), non-GAAP net profit 157m RMB (+57.3%), gross margin 21.0% and C-end retail 48.8% of mix with 1P 2C retail revenue +92.4% (申万宏源 and 招商证券, 2026-08-22/25).

T3 restricted status cuts both ways: with no disclosed float and only 4.2m USD daily turnover, a short is hard to build, hard to exit, and mechanically exposed to a violent squeeze on any beat - the borrow score of 90.0 in the screen is not evidence that stock is actually available.
catalysts: Q3 2026 results versus the 6.34-6.44bn RMB guidance range - the first check on whether the Q2 beat was trade-in pull-forward.

Q4 2026 iPhone launch pricing, which 开源证券 (2026-07-30) identifies as the core input to used-device realisable values; a new-device price increase is the bull version and a price cut is the bear version.
Progress on the overseas push (FoneSquare B2B platform, ReRe consumer brand, 120m HKD June export volume) which requires working capital before it earns any.
Buyback execution against the remaining 35.2m USD authorisation expiring June 2027 - a signal of whether management defends the equity or issues into it.
Any change in the 国补 trade-in subsidy environment, which several brokers name as the demand driver.

theses.name: Planet Green Holdings Corp.
theses.one_liner: Planet Green's USD 10.9m market cap rests on 8.4m of TTM revenue that is one March-2026 quarter, while the share count rose 95% YoY and X flagged a fresh USD 9m offering.
theses.thesis: The market is paying USD 10.9m for a diversified holding company whose FY2025 revenue was 3.0m, and whose TTM 8.4m is almost entirely the single March-2026 quarter (6.36m) - the June-2026 quarter fell back to 790k. The mechanism is the financing treadmill: the share count rose 95.4% YoY (heavy-dilution flag) alongside a 2026 filing sequence of a registration statement (17 Mar), an amendment (2 Apr), a July prospectus supplement and a September preliminary proxy, with a 4 Sep 2026 X post calling it a 'dilution machine' that priced a USD 9m offering. With TTM operating cash flow of just 264k - all of it the March quarter's 4.58m, against -4.56m in the June quarter - the equity is funded by issuance into a tape already down 63.7% over one year and 91.5% over three.
bear_points: Revenue collapsed from 44.8m in FY2022 to 17.7m (FY2023), 4.69m (FY2024) and 3.04m (FY2025); the TTM 8.44m figure is one spike quarter (March 2026 at 6.36m), after which June 2026 fell back to 790k.
FY2025 gross margin fell to 3.32% from 11.82% in FY2024, with operating margin -580% and net margin -887%; TTM net loss is 26.0m on 8.44m of revenue.

Share count rose 95.4% YoY (dilution_yoy), consistent with the heavy-dilution flag and the 2026 filing sequence: registration statement 17 Mar 2026, registration-statement amendment 2 Apr 2026, prospectus supplement 14 Jul 2026, preliminary proxy 11 Sep 2026.
Cash generation is not self-funding: TTM operating cash flow of 264k is entirely the March-2026 quarter's 4.58m and the June-2026 quarter burned 4.56m; FY2025 operating cash flow was -1.79m.

Short mechanics are neither crowded nor clean: SI is 1.0% of an 11.64m float (SI-at-floor flag) with 505,936 shares short, market cap is USD 10.9m against USD 3.45m of average daily turnover, and the tape is -63.7% 1y / -67.5% YTD / -91.5% 3y.
risks_to_short: The screen's shortability score is the highest in this batch (47.1/100, conviction 62.9), and at a USD 10.9m market cap with USD 3.45m of daily turnover a single contract announcement or a repeat of the March-2026 quarter produces a violent re-rate - the short needs the treadmill, not just weakness.

The only primary X evidence is one 4 Sep 2026 dilution warning from @smith_will86715 with 0-2 likes and under 500 views; there is no institutional short thesis, no 13F and no forensic thread, so the short has no crowd to share the catalyst with.

No sell-side coverage exists to mark the story: the AlphaEngine pull returned 12 company filings and the PLAG.A keyword's 70 hits were all off-target broker strategy notes, so there is no broker target or estimate to converge toward.

The March-2026 quarter printed positive net income (+4.91% margin) and positive operating cash flow (4.58m); one more such quarter would let the 'dilution machine' narrative be reframed as a turnaround, and the June-2026 collapse is a single quarter of counter-evidence.
catalysts: Any takedown off the 14 Jul 2026 prospectus supplement - a new pricing would be the direct trigger the X dilution warning is keyed to.
The 11 Sep 2026 preliminary proxy statement, i.e. what the company is asking shareholders to approve.
The next quarterly report; the latest in the bundle is the 14 Aug 2026 filing covering the June-2026 quarter, which will show whether the March revenue spike was real.
FY2026 results against the 3.04m FY2025 base (the last annual report in the bundle is the 31 Mar 2026 2025年报).

theses.name: Autohome Inc. Class A
theses.one_liner: Autohome revenue fell 31.3% YoY in Q2 2026 as the auto downcycle deepened, yet the stock trades at 18.5x trailing earnings - a trading short at best, with a 23% shareholder-return yield as the floor.
theses.thesis: Autohome's problem is structural rather than cyclical: the revenue base is shrinking faster than the cost base can follow, so operating leverage runs in reverse. Revenue fell from RMB 7,139.4m (FY2024) to RMB 6,280.0m (FY2025) and Q2 2026 revenue fell 31.3% YoY to RMB 1,196m, while gross margin slipped from 80.26% (FY2022) to 74.37% (FY2025) and operating margin from 17.55% to 12.26%; Q1 2026 net margin collapsed to 4.22% from 23.42% a year earlier. The sell-side has been cutting for a year: HSBC downgraded Buy to Hold with the target cut from USD 25.50 to USD 17.30 (2026-05-14) and Nomura cut to Underperform with a USD 19 target (2026-08-18). The counterweight is that the company still generates cash - TTM free cash flow of RMB 747.6m (USD 105.3m), a 1.09% FCF yield - and J.P.Morgan (2026-08-03) calculates a 23% total shareholder return from a new USD 400m buyback plus dividend. That is a floor under a short, not a reason to own the equity, and it is why this is a trading short at best rather than a position.
bear_points: Revenue declined in every recent period: FY2025 RMB 6,280.0m (-12.0% versus FY2024), Q1 2026 RMB 1,044.0m (-28.0% YoY) and Q2 2026 RMB 1,196m (-31.3% YoY). The screen's 'revenue collapse' flag is on and rev_yoy is -31.3%.

Margins are decaying with the revenue: gross margin 80.26% (FY2022) to 74.37% (FY2025), operating margin 17.55% to 12.26%, and Q1 2026 net margin 4.22% versus 23.42% in Q1 2025 before recovering to 20.69% in Q2 2026.

The end market, not execution, is the constraint: J.P.Morgan (2026-08-03) expected Q2 2026 revenue -32% as the domestic auto downcycle dragged, and its 2026-03-11 note cites industry margins at 4.1% in 2025 with 2026 total volume growth of 1%, the weakest in years.

Nomura cut to Underperform on 2026-08-18 (target from USD 20.2 to USD 19), forecasting 2026 revenue -25% and adjusted net profit -39% with long-term growth far below peers; HSBC had already downgraded to Hold on 2026-05-14 with the target cut from USD 25.50 to USD 17.30.

The multiple still requires the old business: 18.50x trailing and 15.47x forward earnings, 12.34x trailing sales and 3.00x book, on a TTM net margin of 17.05% that is itself down from 26.04% in FY2022.
risks_to_short: The capital-return floor is large and committed: J.P.Morgan (2026-08-03) cites a new USD 400m buyback on top of the annual dividend for a 23% total shareholder return, and its 2026-03-11 note puts the 18-month authorisation at up to USD 200m with a dividend of at least RMB 1.5bn. Carrying a short against a 23% return yield is expensive.

J.P.Morgan also says the shares trade below net cash (2026-08-03); the screen's EV of USD 9,342m against an USD 9,649m market cap implies a net cash cushion, and any Chinese auto-stimulus headline hits a 0.224-beta name whose short interest is only 6.2% of the 57.80m-share float.

The Q2 2026 print was better than the collapse narrative: HSBC kept Hold but raised its target back to USD 23.5 from USD 17.30 on 2026-08-21 after Q2 beat, with net margin recovering to 20.69%. New-business optionality - over 100 offline franchise stores (家家好车), a first used-car export, an AI vertical agent, 76.5m mobile DAU in June - could change the mix.

Borrow is frictionless (screen borrow score 90.0) and there is no crowded short to squeeze, which cuts both ways: no squeeze fuel against the position, but also no borrow friction to stop a re-rate on any recovery datapoint.
catalysts: Q3 2026 results and whether the -31.3% Q2 revenue decline is the trough.
Monthly passenger-vehicle retail data and the auto-industry margin trend J.P.Morgan tracks as the core demand input.
Buyback execution against the USD 400m authorisation and the annual dividend of at least RMB 1.5bn.
Progress on the O2O/线下加盟 rollout (家家好车), used-car exports and the AI product, which HSBC says must be watched before the fundamentals turn (2026-08-21).

theses.name: Baidu, Inc. Class A
theses.one_liner: Baidu's ad revenue fell 19% YoY in Q2 2026, FY2025 operating cash flow went negative and FCF hit -15.0bn RMB on 12.1bn RMB of capex - a capex/free-cash-flow short, not a broken-business short.
theses.thesis: The market is being asked to underwrite an AI-cloud transformation at 1.7x sales and 0.79x book, but the transformation is being paid for out of the cash flow of a declining core: Q2 2026 advertising revenue fell about 19% YoY (中信建投 2026-08-27) while AI cloud infrastructure grew 50% and GPU cloud 283%, and TTM revenue is -3.5% YoY. The cash-flow damage is already booked - FY2025 operating cash flow swung from +21,535m RMB to -2,933m RMB and FCF from +13,402m RMB to -15,012m RMB as capex rose to 12,079m RMB - and the operating margin fell from 15.75% (2024) to -4.64% (2025). The screen's own read agrees this is not a weak-tape short: score_thesis 52.7, conviction 60.5 and a weakness score of 26, with the Street split between Morgan Stanley Underweight at 80 and Citi at 166.
bear_points: The core is shrinking faster than AI is filling in: TTM revenue -3.5% YoY and TTM revenue 3-year CAGR of -0.29%, with Q2 2026 revenue of 31,266m RMB against 32,402m RMB a year earlier; advertising revenue fell about 19% YoY (中信建投 2026-08-27) even as AI cloud infrastructure grew 50%.

FY2025 cash flow broke: operating cash flow -2,933m RMB (from +21,535m RMB in 2024) and FCF -15,012m RMB on capex of 12,079m RMB, with the operating margin at -4.64% versus +15.75% in 2024 and gross margin down from 49.64% to 45.11%.
TTM is still negative on FCF: -2,274m RMB (-320m USD) with a -1.0% FCF yield and capex now 9.6% of revenue, against a forward PE of 14.6x that assumes the AI spend earns a return.
The credit view has turned: Moody's cut the outlook to negative with A3 affirmed on AI capital costs weighing on margins (X, @newsinvesting, 2026-09-24, citing the rating action).

The screen's own conviction is low for a reason: score_thesis 52.7 against score_shortable 69.5, with weakness at 26 of 100 - this is a capex-and-FCF short on a name whose tape is not broken (-21.1% over three months but +10.7% net margin in Q1 2026).
risks_to_short: The asset value is enormous and being unlocked: more than 40bn USD of cash and total investments and a 57.7-58% stake in Kunlunxin carried at a 50bn USD valuation in two separate notes (华安证券 2026-09-07; Citi 2026-09-02) - a sum-of-parts re-rate or asset monetisation is the direct break.

A mechanical southbound bid arrived: the HK dual-primary listing took effect 2026-09-01 with southbound inclusion on 2026-09-07 (华安证券 2026-09-07; 中信证券 2026-08-27), and Morgan Stanley estimates 3-6.8bn USD of inflows over 6-12 months even from an Underweight rating.

The cash-flow trough may already be behind it: quarterly operating cash flow recovered to +2,659m RMB in Q1 2026 and +3,427m RMB in Q2 2026, and Goldman Sachs (2026-09-02) reports management guiding capex down in coming quarters with a first dividend targeted by end-2026 - both are re-rating catalysts against the short.

The bull targets are double the bear ones: Citi Buy at 166 (2026-09-09) and 中信建投 Buy at 180 (2026-08-27) versus Morgan Stanley Underweight at 80 (2026-08-27) and a 89.78 close - the dispersion is the trade, and it cuts both ways.
catalysts: Moody's negative outlook resolution on the A3 rating (X, @newsinvesting, 2026-09-24).
Q3 2026 results, and whether advertising revenue decline moderates from the -19% YoY seen in Q2 2026.
First dividend targeted by end-2026 with capex guided lower in coming quarters (Goldman Sachs 2026-09-02).
Southbound inclusion effective 2026-09-07 and the associated 3-6.8bn USD inflow estimate over 6-12 months (Morgan Stanley 2026-08-27).
Apollo Go expansion: 28 cities, about 1m fully driverless rides in Q2 2026 and over 23m cumulative public rides (华安证券 2026-08-28) - either a value-unlock event or another loss-making capex line.

x_sentiment.lean: A near-term technical bear and a fresh credit-outlook cut on one side, dip-buyers on the other - not a short campaign.
x_sentiment.notes: In the mega1 sweep BIDU is described as mixed: the bear inputs are the Moody's negative outlook (X, 2026-09-24), a technical post calling for a lower low (@EchoAnalysis, 2026-09-16), the Beijing AI probe headlines that hit the whole group (@davidmoadel, 2026-09-23) and one uncorroborated retail post citing Burry-avoid-Alibaba logic. The sweep explicitly notes the bearish reasons are being discussed as the price of the long rather than argued as a short book, and that no named activist report exists.

sellside.consensus: 12 documents split three ways with no consensus: Citi at 166 and 中信建投 at 180 are Buy on AI-cloud and value-unlocking, 国泰海通 is at 123 HKD constructive, and Morgan Stanley is Underweight at 80 on rising AI investment with limited core-ad recovery. The one fact everyone shares is that advertising is contracting while AI cloud compounds.

theses.name: Canadian Solar Inc.
theses.one_liner: Canadian Solar burned USD 1,815m of free cash flow TTM against a USD 799m market cap, yet 40.6% of its float is already short - the thesis is real, the trade is crowded.
theses.thesis: The market reads Canadian Solar as a storage growth story: H1 2026 storage revenue of RMB 5,659m (44.3% of the total) on 6.1GWh of shipments, up 103.3%, with a USD 3.5bn storage backlog, and the sell-side has cut without capitulating (UBS Neutral, A-share target cut to RMB 9.80 on 2026-09-01). The funding is the problem. TTM operating cash flow was -USD 852.7m, capex USD 962.3m and free cash flow -USD 1,815.0m against an USD 799m market cap - a -227.1% FCF yield - with operating cash flow negative in five of the last six quarters. Q2 2026 revenue fell 29% YoY to USD 1,208m with a USD 77m net loss and group gross margin of 13.9% versus 29.8% a year earlier, because the module business was deliberately shrunk 60% YoY to conserve cash. The gap closes only if storage cash generation outruns the US capacity build; 9.34% YoY dilution says it has not so far. What makes the risk/reward poor is that the short is already consensus: the screen's fields put 17,700,892 short shares at 40.6% of the 43.62m-share float, borrow is the tightest in this batch (borrow score 42.0), and X is openly campaigning to fade the shorts.
bear_points: TTM free cash flow of -USD 1,815.0m on a -227.1% FCF yield against an USD 799m market cap and an EV of USD 2,014m - the equity is levered to a cash deficit it cannot fund internally.

Operating cash flow was negative in five of the last six quarters: -USD 264.2m (Q1 2025), +USD 188.3m (Q2 2025), -USD 113.5m (Q3 2025), -USD 346.6m (Q4 2025), -USD 208.7m (Q1 2026), -USD 184.0m (Q2 2026).

Q2 2026 revenue USD 1,208m (-29% YoY), net loss USD 77m, group gross margin 13.9% versus 25.1% in Q1 2026 and 29.8% in Q2 2025; the manufacturing segment swung from a USD 127m operating profit in Q1 2026 to a USD 49m operating loss, with segment gross margin at 11.9% from 29.1% (中金公司, 2026-08-27).

The core module business is shrinking, not merely slowing: H1 2026 module revenue RMB 3,793m, -73.6% YoY, on 3.9GW of shipments, and Q2 module shipments of 3.1GW were -60% YoY (国联民生证券 2026-08-31, 中金公司 2026-08-27).

Dilution of 9.34% year over year while FCF is -USD 1.8bn, on top of an A-share subsidiary (CSI Solar, 688472) whose H1 2026 attributable profit fell 59% to RMB 300m and whose recurring profit swung to a RMB 250m loss, dragged by a RMB 409m FX loss (中邮证券 2026-09-08, 东吴证券 2026-08-31).
risks_to_short: The crowd is on the other side and borrow is the binding constraint: the screen's borrow score is 42.0, the worst of these ten names, with 17,700,892 shares short - 40.6% of the 43.62m-share float. The sweep's dominant call is a squeeze, with an analyst post on 2026-09-04 telling holders to turn share-lending off and citing a prior short-interest unwind that took the stock from USD 9 to USD 34.

Storage is real and profitable: H1 2026 storage revenue RMB 5,659m (+27.7% YoY, 44.3% of revenue), shipments 6.1GWh (+103.3%), segment net profit RMB 678m at about RMB 0.11/Wh, and a USD 3.5bn order backlog at Q2-end, with full-year guidance of 14-17GWh (华泰证券 2026-08-28, 长江证券 2026-08-28).

US capacity is a hard asset with a stated return: the 2GW cell plant started in July 2026 and reaches full output in October, the 5GW module plant is at full utilisation, and the company claims over USD 4.5bn of US module orders plus a retained 24.9% stake that will generate rent and investment income (国金证券 2026-08-27, Q2 2026 transcript).
Beta of 1.514 into any China-stimulus or solar-policy headline cuts both ways on a USD 24.9m ADT, and the stock has already fallen 25.9% in a month and 54.7% YTD, so much of the de-rating is booked.
catalysts: Q3 2026 results against the USD 1.3-1.5bn revenue guide given with the Q2 print (2026-08-27 transcript).
The US 2GW cell plant reaching full output in October 2026, and first recognition of rent and investment income from the restructured US business.
Storage deliveries against the 14-17GWh 2026 guidance and whether the roughly RMB 0.1/Wh unit net profit holds as lithium carbonate costs rise (长江证券, 2026-08-28).
Any further equity or REIT-style financing: group free cash flow is -USD 1.8bn TTM and dilution already ran 9.34% YoY.

x_sentiment.lean: The crowd is long the squeeze, not short the fundamentals - 'largest short interest ever' and calls to turn share-lending off.
x_sentiment.notes: The energy1 batch sweep names CSIQ directly and rates it the strongest of the five energy names, but the density is anti-short: almost nobody in the window articulates why the shorts are right. The single explicit breakdown short is a paid technical account targeting USD 8.49 below USD 11.83 (@StockConsultant, 2026-09-17); the rest is squeeze advocacy and unverified short-interest figures (37-40% of float) that I have not independently confirmed. Treat it as a crowded-short warning, not as confirmation.

sellside.consensus: Twelve documents, all constructive-to-neutral after H1 2026: the Chinese brokers stay Buy or positive and UBS cut its A-share target to RMB 9.80 but stayed Neutral. No broker in the bundle carries a Sell; the bear content is the FX loss, the gross-margin reset and the shrunken module base.

theses.name: XPeng, Inc. ADR Sponsored Class A
theses.one_liner: XPeng's Q2 2026 vehicle gross margin was 12.1% while services carried 75.1%, deliveries were flat YoY, and TTM FCF is -6,082m RMB.
theses.thesis: The market is paying for a physical-AI platform while the car business stalls: Q2 2026 vehicle gross margin was 12.1%, down 2.2 points YoY, against 75.1% in services and others (国泰海通 2026-09-17), which is why the best-structured bear on X describes the record consolidated margin as mostly VW technology services. Volumes have stopped compounding - Q2 deliveries were flat at 103k (+0.1% YoY) and cumulative January-August 2026 deliveries were 243k, down 10.5% YoY (长江证券 2026-09-08) - while Q1 2026 revenue fell 17.7% YoY to 12,979m RMB with a -13.7% net margin and TTM FCF is -6,082m RMB (-856m USD). The share count is up 27.6% YoY, 东吴证券 still models a 4,425m RMB loss for 2026, and the bull case has migrated entirely to a robot unit that raised 900m USD at a 6.3bn USD valuation but sells nothing at scale yet.
bear_points: The margin is not a car margin: Q2 2026 consolidated gross margin of 20.7% came with vehicle gross margin of 12.1% (-2.2 points YoY) and 75.1% in services and others (国泰海通 2026-09-17).

Volume growth has stopped: Q2 2026 deliveries 103k, +0.1% YoY; January-August 2026 cumulative 243k, -10.5% YoY, with August at 39,107 units (+3.7% YoY) and the Q3 guide of 115-120k (长江证券 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-08).
The top line can go backwards: Q1 2026 revenue 12,979m RMB was 17.7% below Q1 2025's 15,771m RMB with a -13.7% net margin, and TTM net loss is 3,112m RMB on a -4.2% net margin.

Cash burn persists through the growth story: TTM operating cash outflow 2,924m RMB, capex 3,158m RMB and FCF -6,082m RMB (-856m USD); 东吴证券 (2026-09-02) still models 2026-2028 net losses of 4,425m, 1,279m RMB before a 2,433m RMB profit in 2028.
Shareholders fund the gap: share count +27.6% YoY, the screen's 'heavy dilution' flag, alongside 'cash burner' and 'broken tape' with a -52.0% 12-month and -49.4% YTD return.
risks_to_short: The robot optionality is a dated catalyst, not a slide: IRON mass production is targeted for end-2026 with a 7bn RMB full-year physical-AI R&D budget (中信建投 2026-09-18), the first automated humanoid production line is running at over 80% core-process automation (上海证券 2026-09-15) and the unit raised over 900m USD at a post-money valuation above 6.3bn USD while remaining consolidated (国泰海通 2026-09-17).

There is no funding cliff and the multiple is already low: 40.48bn RMB of cash at Q2 2026 (中信建投 2026-09-18) against a 9.88bn USD market cap, with PS 0.92 and EV/sales 0.86 - this is not a solvency short.

The sell-side is constructive on a re-acceleration path: Q3 2026 guidance is 115-120k deliveries and 21.7-23.4bn RMB revenue (+6.5% to +14.8% YoY), overseas deliveries were over 20k in Q2 (+81%) at an ASP above 40k EUR and over 25% of revenue, and MONA L03 global deliveries start in Q4 (西部证券 2026-09-21; 长江证券 2026-09-08).

Borrow is not tight and the short base is not extreme: 45.16m shares short is 4.86% of shares outstanding on an 84.7m USD ADT with a 1.10 beta, so a squeeze is not the mechanism - the risk is simply that overseas volume restarts the delivery line.
catalysts: Q3 2026 results against the 115-120k delivery and 21.7-23.4bn RMB revenue guide (长江证券 2026-09-08).

theses.thesis: The market is holding CNTB at USD 1.07 on two broker targets (Piper Sandler USD 7, Cantor USD 4) and a pending late-September COPD readout, even though the Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT acute-asthma primary endpoint missed - Cantor's own 15 Sep 2026 title is 'A Miss - But Maybe Not on the Endpoint That Ultimately Matters?'. The mechanism is financing: the screen gives 0.4 years of runway on TTM free cash flow of -61.9m against a USD 76.5m market cap (a -80.9% FCF yield), so a raise is a matter of when, and it now prices after a -53.2% month and a -60.0% YTD move, versus USD 2.07 at Piper's June initiation. Runway is 0.4 years (runway<2y flag) on TTM operating cash flow of -61.5m and free cash flow of -61.9m, with the equity down 53.2% in one month, 44.5% in three months and 60.0% YTD - so any raise prices far below the June 2026 initiation level of USD 2.07.

theses.name: GDS Holdings Ltd. Class A
theses.one_liner: Market pays 13x EV/EBITDA and 126x forward earnings for a 2028 EBITDA inflection while GDS burns 1.1bn RMB of free cash a year and diluted holders 15% in the last twelve months.
theses.thesis: The Street is long the order book: Q2 2026 brought record bookings, the 2026 target was raised from 500MW to 1GW, and sell-side TPs cluster at 45.7-52 USD against a 33.11 close. But guidance was raised together with capex - from 9bn to 10bn RMB - and management itself flagged that renewals and western low-price contracts drag unit EBITDA through 2026-27, with the EBITDA acceleration now a 2H27 event (Goldman, 2026-08-16). Screen TTM free cash flow is -1,116m RMB (-157m USD) with capex at 38.5% of revenue, and 2025 was the fourth consecutive negative-FCF year (-1,418m RMB). The gap closes if funding costs rise or the 2028 move-in slips again, because consensus already capitalises a year that is not yet contracted.
bear_points: TTM free cash flow -1,115.9m RMB (-157.1m USD) on 12,190m RMB revenue; capex intensity 38.5% of sales and rising, with 2025 capex of 4,693.6m RMB against operating cash flow of 3,275.5m RMB.
Dilution of 15.19% year-over-year - shareholders are funding the build; the 2026 booking target being doubled to 1GW came with capex guidance lifted from 9bn to 10bn RMB (J.P.Morgan, 2026-08-16).

The earnings inflection is pushed out, not pulled in: Goldman (2026-08-16) says renewal repricing drags unit EBITDA and acceleration starts 2H27; J.P.Morgan (2026-08-16) sees monthly service fees falling for another 18 months with gross margin held at 10-11%.

Valuation already discounts the good outcome: EV/EBITDA TTM 13.09x, P/S 3.92x, forward P/E 126.5x against TTM GAAP net margin of 30.8% that is flattered by items - the 2Q26 GAAP profit of 838m RMB reversed a 71m RMB loss a year earlier (国泰海通, 2026-08-13).

The C-REIT monetisation catalyst was missed: the NDRC approved two data-centre REIT projects but GDS was not among them, and Goldman (2026-07-09) cut the probability of an asset injection this year, modelling 2H26 revenue +8% with EBITDA flat.
risks_to_short: The 2027 move-in ramp is real: contracted and pre-contracted area reached 784,800 sqm (+18.2% YoY) with billed area 542,200 sqm (+13.2%), and management guided year-end backlog to 1.2GW - if that converts, 2028 revenue growth of 20%+ (Goldman, 2026-09-03) re-rates the equity.

Unanimous broker support (Nomura/HSBC/GS/UBS/Citi Buy, two of them with 42-44% implied upside) means every data point on bookings gets bought; this is a crowded long, not a crowded short, and 8.88% short interest is fuel for a squeeze on a booking beat.

The 2026 guide was raised, not cut: revenue guidance moved to 12.7-13.0bn RMB (+11.1-13.7%) and adjusted EBITDA midpoint to 6.0bn RMB (+2% at the midpoint) - a short thesis that needs the guide to break has no evidence of that yet (UBS, 2026-08-14).

Borrow is available (screen borrow score 42.0 with 8.88% SI utilised), but a Baupost/Klarman-style institutional holder (2.09% of that 13F slice, X post 2026-09-20) is a price-insensitive long that can absorb supply; beta is only 0.427, so index hedges will not carry the position.

theses.one_liner: Atour grew revenue 42.5% YoY and free cash flow to USD 315.7m, but diluted shareholders 41.6% with no float data - a dilution and valuation bet against a company that keeps beating.
theses.thesis: This is a dilution-and-valuation short against a business that is executing, so it should be traded, not owned. The operating record argues the other way: TTM revenue of RMB 11,648.4m with 42.5% YoY growth and a 60.2% three-year CAGR, a 16.75% TTM net margin, TTM free cash flow of RMB 2,242.0m (USD 315.7m) and a 6.99% FCF yield, on capex of only 3.6% of revenue. The bear case therefore rests on the share count and the price paid for growth, not on the P&L - and with short interest at 2.09% of an unknown float and a borrow score of 90.0, the mechanic is not on the short's side either. Label it a trading short at best.
bear_points: Dilution of 41.55% year over year - the screen's 'heavy dilution' flag - against TTM revenue of RMB 11,648m and free cash flow of RMB 2,242m: the share count is growing faster than per-share value.

The bundle carries no float data ('no float data' flag) with only 2,911,773 shares short reported, so both the short base and the available borrow are unquantifiable; a 2.09% short ratio on an unknown denominator is not a signal in either direction.

Valuation is at the top of this batch: 15.94x trailing and 14.02x forward earnings, 9.09x book and 11.20x EV/EBITDA, on a business whose operating margin of 24.22% in FY2025 sits above a TTM net margin of 16.75%.

The retail segment carrying the growth is lower-quality than the hotel franchise: H1 2026 retail revenue was RMB 2,646m (+59.5%, 42.0% of the total) against franchise and management revenue of RMB 3,293m (+41.3%, 52.3%), and group guidance has retail growth staying near 40% (光大证券 2026-08-26).
The tape is weak despite the beats: -16.4% YTD, -16.6% over twelve months, -10.9% over six months and -6.9% in the last month - the market is not paying up for 42% revenue growth.
risks_to_short: The company beat and raised: Q2 2026 revenue of RMB 3,490m (+41.4%), adjusted net profit of RMB 558m (+30.8%), full-year revenue growth guidance lifted to +30% from 24-28% and retail growth guidance lifted to about +40% from 30-35% (中信建投 2026-08-23, 华泰证券 2026-08-22, 招商证券 2026-08-21).

theses.thesis: The market is underwriting a module-price recovery into 2027. theses.one_liner: No short exists on this bundle: NetEase generates 56.7bn RMB of TTM free cash flow at 16.3x earnings with no screen flags, and every sell-side document is constructive.
theses.thesis: This is the wrong name in a short book. The only bear inputs in the bundle are earnings-quality ones that do not survive contact with the cash flow: Q2 2026 GAAP net profit fell 19% YoY to about 7bn RMB because of 2.95bn RMB of investment losses, roughly 2bn RMB of it fair-value marks on PDD and Alibaba and about 1bn RMB of private-market impairments (中信建投 2026-08-25) - while the game business grew 9.7% with gross margin up to 76.1% and operating profit up 33.4%. The screen's own score_thesis of 45.9 and conviction of 54.3 are the honest reading, and the 0.2-of-100 weakness score says there is no broken tape to trade against either.
bear_points: The one genuine bear input is that headline earnings are noisy and negative: Q2 2026 GAAP net profit fell 19% YoY on 2.95bn RMB of investment losses, including roughly 2bn RMB of fair-value marks on PDD and Alibaba and about 1bn RMB of private-market impairments, with the effective tax rate rising to 25.5% (中信建投 2026-08-25; 国信证券 2026-08-24).

Excluding the marks the business still grew: non-GAAP Q2 2026 net profit was 7.75bn RMB (-18.7% YoY) but profit excluding investment losses was 10.7bn RMB, up 13% YoY, with games revenue up 9.7% to 25.0bn RMB and operating profit up 33.4% (国信证券 2026-08-24; 中信建投 2026-08-25).

New-product monetisation is the soft spot the Street itself flags: 遗忘之海 launched in July 2026 with initial monetisation below expectations, although the pipeline holds about 18 approved games (中信证券(香港) 2026-08-24).

On sales the stock is not cheap relative to its own history: the only analytical X note on the name says NetEase is cheap on earnings but not on sales, with the price-to-sales ratio above its five-year median (@MapleLeafWealth, 2026-09-21), against PS 4.56 and 16.3x trailing earnings.

Product concentration and franchise risk exist but are not a thesis: the top five games are over 50% of revenue (申万宏源 2026-09-17), and the only consumer backlash in the window is an Identity V player boycott over AI art and alleged racism with no financial thesis attached (X, @rosekgpg, 2026-09-22 to 2026-09-24, 3-49 likes).
risks_to_short: There is no short mechanism here at all: TTM FCF is +56,668m RMB (+7,265m USD), net margin 27.9%, operating cash flow 57,854m RMB, capex just 1,186m RMB (0.91% of revenue), a 9.55% FCF yield and zero screen flags - the company does not need capital and does not burn it.

All 12 sell-side documents are constructive: Goldman Sachs Buy on the conviction list with a 168 target (2026-09-21), Morgan Stanley Overweight at 163 (2026-09-15), 国海证券 upgraded to Buy with a 263 HKD target (2026-08-23), and 国证国际 initiating constructively with 2026-2028 net profit forecasts of 37.9/42.6/47.2bn RMB (2026-09-11).

Mechanical support is on the other side: share count down 20.3% YoY, short interest just 3.05% of shares outstanding (2.66m shares on a 1.75bn share float), and a 93.8m USD ADT - there is no crowded short to feed and nothing to squeeze.

The forward pipeline is the bull case the market is buying: 2027 is described as a product year with 无限大, 归唐, 雾海之下 and 诡影藏锋 (中信建投 2026-08-25; 华泰证券 2026-08-28), and Morgan Stanley (2026-09-15) reads BlizzCon 2026 as positive for the pipeline - any one of these hitting restarts an earnings upgrade cycle that the 11.7x forward multiple does not discount.
