theses.one_liner: Jianzhi has 0.9 years of runway, a 9.5m annual operating cash burn, a share count up 106% YoY and two 2026 prospectus supplements - the raises are the business model.
theses.thesis: The bull case is washout pricing - a USD 7.9m market cap at 0.79x EV/sales - and the mechanism against it is a financing treadmill with a clock: the screen gives JZ 0.9 years of runway on TTM operating cash flow of -9.49m (-1.34m USD), revenue that fell 72.9% YoY to 68.3m in FY2025 from 252.4m in FY2024, and a share count up 106.2% YoY. The bundle corroborates the dilution directly with two 2026 prospectus supplements (29 Jun, 14 Aug) and the X sweep's clearest bear case, @kei44279 (21 Sep 2026): '$JZ at USD 0.64 isn't a dip - it's a broken chart. Down 99.8% in a year, raised USD 5M at USD 1.00 in June, then USD 3.5M in January with heavy dilution. The dip is the business model.' The gap closes only if the raises stop, and a -99.1% one-year tape says they have not.
bear_points: Runway: the screen gives 0.9 years on TTM free cash flow of -9.49m (-1.34m USD) against a USD 7.9m market cap, and net cash is -0.4% of market cap (marginally net debt), so there is no cushion.
The revenue-collapse flag is earned: FY2022 518.2m to FY2023 440.8m to FY2024 252.4m to FY2025 68.3m (-72.9% YoY), with FY2025 operating margin -24.8% and net margin -22.4%.
Dilution is the funding model: share count +106.2% YoY (heavy-dilution flag) with two 2026 招股说明书补充 in the bundle (29 Jun, 14 Aug), on top of the X-cited USD 5m raise at USD 1.00 and a USD 3.5m raise.
Tape: -78.7% 1m, -90.3% 3m, -98.6% 6m, -99.1% 1y, -98.5% YTD at a USD 0.4937 close, with SI at 1.0% and 113,161 shares short on an unknown float ('no float data' and 'SI at floor/unknown' flags).

Coverage void: all six AlphaEngine items are company filings (2025年报 13 Apr 2026; 招股说明书补充 29 Jun and 14 Aug 2026; 重大事件报告 18 Mar, 28 Aug and 1 Sep 2026) - no broker has a published view that the thesis has to beat.
risks_to_short: The screen scores JZ only 28.9/100 on valuation and EV/sales is 0.79x: the equity is already priced close to liquidation, so the short needs the next raise to be struck below spot rather than merely another weak quarter.

The X low-float figures are contradictory and unverified - @ShortSideIO (10 Sep 2026) puts float at about 60K shares and SI at about 40K and concludes 'No shorts to squeeze, just momentum', while the sweep notes another account cites a 2.3m float - and a genuinely tiny float cuts both ways.

A USD 3.5-5m raise is small enough to be absorbed by one investor: a strategic or related-party funding at a premium to the USD 0.4937 close ends the dilution trade immediately, and the June raise clearing at USD 1.00 shows buyers have paid up before.

The `runway<2y` flag is a screen model output, not a company disclosure; the 2025年报 (13 Apr 2026) carries no going-concern caveat in the bundle, and the company has so far raised rather than defaulted.

The next interim/annual filing; the newest in the bundle is the 重大事件报告 of 1 Sep 2026 and the FY2025 年报 of 13 Apr 2026.
FY2026 revenue against the FY2025 68.3m base, which decides whether the -72.9% YoY decline is a level or a trend.

theses.thesis: The screen scores ZKH thesis 67.1, but the driver is a TTM net margin of -0.03% and 0.34x sales, not a deteriorating business: 2Q26 GMV rose 18.9% to RMB 2.9bn, revenue rose 12.8% to RMB 2.4bn, and the company posted its first positive quarterly operating profit (Q2 call, 2026-08-21). bear_points: Profitability is wafer-thin: FY2025 gross margin 16.9% and net margin -1.6%; TTM net margin -0.03% and TTM free cash flow -USD 6.3m, with the screen flagging 'cash burner'.

The screen flags 'heavy dilution' with dilution_yoy 4.16 and 'no float data'; the magnitude of that dilution figure is not reliable because the ADR ratio and share float are both missing, but the flag and the missing-float condition are screen outputs.

Liquidity and borrow are poor: average daily turnover USD 1.15m, a T3 restricted tier, and only 18,185 shares short (si_ratio 1.0) - there is no short base and no depth to exit into if the inflection stalls.

The 2026 equity story needs a 1.4% net margin and full-year profit (Huatai initiation, 2026-07-21, PT 4.30; Deutsche Bank 2026-08-21, PT 4.8); at a 16.9% gross margin a single soft GMV quarter reverses the whole case.
risks_to_short: The earnings inflection is documented, not hoped for: 2Q26 first positive quarterly operating profit, GMV +18.9%, revenue +12.8%, FY GMV guidance of 15-20% growth and overseas profitability guided for 2H26 (Q2 call, 2026-08-21).
Deutsche Bank maintained Buy with PT 4.8 on 2026-08-21 (71% above the 2.81 close) and raised FY26 forecasts; Huatai initiated Buy with PT 4.30 on 2026-07-21.

A Hong Kong listing is under discussion: CFO Max Lai told Bloomberg the company has been working with banks and counsel on an HK IPO (Huatai note, 2026-03-24), which is a re-rate catalyst against the short.

theses.one_liner: Kingsoft Cloud is spending 5.28bn RMB of capex a year against a 686m RMB operating cash inflow to buy 39% revenue growth it still cannot turn into profit.
theses.thesis: The bull case is the AI-cloud inflection: 2Q26 revenue 3.07bn RMB (+30.8%), AI cloud billings +82% to 1.327bn RMB at 43% of revenue and 56% of public cloud, gross margin 15.2%, and the first positive GAAP operating profit at 23m RMB (multiple brokers, 2026-08-20/27). The screen shows how thin that inflection is: TTM net loss 677.4m RMB on 12,326m RMB of revenue, capex of 5,279m RMB against TTM operating cash flow of 6,861m RMB, leaving only 1,582m RMB of TTM FCF against a 3,057m USD market cap. Management has guided 2026 capex of 15bn RMB (Morgan Stanley, 2026-09-18; Goldman Sachs, 2026-09-01; Citi, 2026-08-21) and Goldman models a 3.5-year payback on AI IaaS. That payback is a 2029 asset against a 2026 equity price. The gap closes if AI compute supply normalises before the depreciation lands, because the profit is 0.7% of revenue and the depreciation is not yet in the run-rate.
bear_points: Profitability is a rounding error on a capital-intensive base: 2Q26 GAAP operating profit of 23m RMB (0.7% operating margin) on 30.72亿元 of revenue, adjusted operating profit 124m RMB, against a TTM net loss of 677.4m RMB (net margin -5.49%) and a market cap of 3,057m USD.

Capital intensity is the model: TTM capex 5,279m RMB, which is 42.8% of revenue, versus TTM operating cash flow of 6,861m RMB and TTM FCF of 1,582m RMB; the screen flags 'broken tape' with a -41.98% one-year return and the stock down 12.66% in the last month alone.

The 2026 capex plan of 15bn RMB is roughly 2.5x the current market cap in annual spend (Morgan Stanley 2026-09-18; Goldman 2026-09-01; Citi 2026-08-21), and 国元国际 (2026-08-20) records a lower 90亿 RMB figure from the same print - the guidance circulating for this number is not consistent.

Reported estimates still show losses: 国海证券 (2026-08-22) models non-HKFRS net losses of -4.28亿/-2.16亿 RMB for 2026/2027 before turning positive at 1.21亿 RMB in 2028, so the equity is discounting a profit that is two years and several billion RMB of capex away.

Dilution of 19.14% year-over-year, and the revenue base is concentrated: 小米 and 金山 ecosystem revenue was 8.1亿元, 26% of total revenue (国信证券, 2026-08-27) - the growth is related-party and the customer can price it.
risks_to_short: The inflection is happening now, not later: 2Q26 was the first positive GAAP operating quarter, AI cloud billings grew 82% YoY to 13.27亿元, MaaS revenue grew more than 12x QoQ (申万宏源 and 国海证券, 2026-08-22/24), and Goldman (2026-09-01) reports MaaS carries the highest gross margin - a mix shift that could lift margins quickly.

Guidance is intact and management says demand exceeds supply: Morgan Stanley (2026-09-18) records the 35% revenue growth, ~15% gross margin and breakeven operating profit guidance plus an assertion that AI compute shortage lasts another year; 国盛证券 (2026-08-24) shows 2Q26 adjusted operating margin of 4.0% and an EBITDA margin of 35.8%.

Sell-side is almost uniformly long with large implied upside: Morgan Stanley Overweight TP 16 USD (from 15), Citi Buy 18 USD, UBS Buy 19 USD, Deutsche Bank Buy (12 HKD) against a 9.68 close - a booking or margin beat on a 3bn USD market cap with a 1.96 beta is a violent move.

The balance sheet is not obviously stretched: the screen shows a PCF of 3.48x, an EV/Sales of 1.97x and positive TTM FCF of 1,582m RMB, so this is a valuation and depreciation-timing short, not a financing short - and there is no dilution crisis to force the issue.
catalysts: 3Q26 results - the second consecutive positive GAAP operating profit, or its absence, is the whole thesis trigger.
2026 capex execution against the 15bn RMB plan: any upward revision before depreciation scales is the bear case; slippage is the bull case.
AI cloud billings mix and MaaS revenue run-rate, the only line with high gross margin.
Depreciation ramp on the AI IaaS fleet over the next four to six quarters, which Goldman's 3.5-year payback implies but has not yet flowed through the P&L.
Whether the 小米/金山 ecosystem revenue share above 26% of total can be broadened beyond related parties (国信证券, 2026-08-27).

theses.name: Futu Holdings Ltd. Class A
theses.one_liner: Futu's 31% FCF yield is other people's money - customer float - while its unresolved CSRC penalty and US class actions stay open and 3Q26 guidance is the first real test.
theses.thesis: The market is buying a high-growth broker: 2Q26 revenue 72.0亿 HKD (+35.6%), net profit 36.4亿 HKD (+41.6%), total trading volume a record 6.42万亿 HKD (+78.8%) and funded accounts at 3.84m (+33.6%) (东吴证券, 华泰证券, 2026-08-21). The screen shows what that profit actually is: TTM operating cash flow of 34,832m RMB against a 23,033m RMB revenue base - an OCF margin of 151% - because brokerage cash flow includes customer deposits. TTM FCF of 34,783m RMB gives a headline FCF yield of 30.6% that no valuation model should capitalise. The real risk is regulatory: the CSRC proposed a fine of roughly 1.85bn RMB (about 271m USD) on 22 May 2026 on unlicensed mainland securities and fund business, plus a personal fine for the CEO, and August 2026 US securities-fraud class actions allege the conduct continued (documented on X by @MertOnMarkets, 2026-09-01). That is unresolved, and the company itself guided to a softer 3Q26 (J.P.Morgan, 2026-08-21; Citi, 2026-08-20).
bear_points: The cash flow is not earnings: TTM operating cash flow 34,832m RMB on TTM revenue of 23,033m RMB (OCF margin 1.51x) and TTM net income 9,901m RMB - the 30.6% FCF yield in the screen is customer float, not distributable profit, so the 'cheap on cash flow' argument is invalid.

Regulatory overhang is unresolved: a proposed CSRC fine of about RMB 1.85bn (roughly 271m USD) dated 22 May 2026 over unlicensed mainland securities, fund and futures business plus a personal CEO fine, with mainland accounts about 13% of the book and the stock -11.6% on the day; August 2026 US securities class actions allege the conduct continued (@MertOnMarkets, 2026-09-01, 445 views).

The company guided down for 3Q26: J.P.Morgan (2026-08-21) and Citi (2026-08-20) both flag softer third-quarter operating guidance and renewed onshore regulatory uncertainty, and 华泰证券 notes the 1Q penalty distorted the sequential comparison (2Q net profit +329% QoQ, or +25% excluding the penalty).

Revenue concentration in a single product: US equities were 78.2% of 2Q26 trading volume (东吴证券) or 78% (华泰证券, 中金公司), so the growth is levered to US market activity and to the mainland-to-offshore funnel that the CSRC action targets.

The equity is not working: -33.7% over 1 year and -11.4% over 1 month with a forward P/E of 8.01x against a TTM P/E of 10.83x - a de-rating in progress despite record volumes, and only 2.67% of float short, so the market is not positioned for it.
risks_to_short: Operationally this was a blowout quarter: 2Q26 revenue 72.0亿 HKD (+35.6% YoY), net profit 36.4亿 HKD (+41.6%), record 6.42万亿 HKD trading volume (+78.8%), margin balance 951亿 HKD (+85.1%) and client assets 1.40万亿 HKD (+43.6%) with 252k net new funded accounts (东吴证券, 华泰证券, 中金公司, 2026-08-21).

Sell-side TPs were raised, not cut, on the print: 招银国际 to 158 USD, Citi to 157 USD, Deutsche Bank to 148 USD from 136, 中金公司 to 147 USD, J.P.Morgan to 122 USD and Goldman to 121.82 USD - five of those came within two days of results.

The overseas mix is diversifying away from the regulatory risk: overseas clients are now close to 60% of the base with Malaysia the largest single contributor of net new accounts and Singapore, the US and Hong Kong adding materially (中金公司, 2026-08-21; 招银国际).

Only 2.67% of float is short with borrow flagged as available and the screen's borrow component at 90.0, so a penalty resolution or a strong 3Q26 beat has no offsetting short base - and the 'no float data' flag means position sizing on the short side is blind.
catalysts: Final CSRC penalty determination, the open item since the 22 May 2026 proposal - the size and any business restrictions are the binary.
August 2026 US securities-fraud class actions and their discovery milestones.
3Q26 operational update, which the company itself guided softer (J.P.Morgan and Citi, 2026-08-20/21).
Whether the penalty-driven 1Q26 charge repeats or reverses in the 3Q26 income statement, which 华泰证券 identifies as the reason 2Q26 net profit rose 329% QoQ.
Mainland asset-outflow trends, which 华泰证券 says slowed in August 2026 - an improvement that would weaken this thesis.

theses.name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited
theses.one_liner: Alibaba's operating margin halved to 5.0% and FCF turned to -59.1bn RMB in FY2026 as capex hit 143.3bn RMB - a trading short on a capex cycle, at best.
theses.thesis: The market is paying 1.9x book for an AI-infrastructure story whose bill is already in the accounts: FY2026 (ended March 2026) capex reached 143,251m RMB, up 55% from 92,171m RMB, which turned FCF from +84,059m RMB to -59,146m RMB, and the operating margin halved from 14.07% to 5.04%. TTM FCF is -55,280m RMB (-7,087m USD) and the June-2026 quarter showed Non-GAAP net profit down 38% YoY even as revenue grew 9% (长江证券 2026-09-22). Everything the sell-side values is forward-dated - a 20GW data-centre target for 2032, a V900 chip shipping 2027Q1, Qwen at 5-10T parameters - and the near-term bear is regulatory, with Alibaba among five firms reported summoned in a CAC probe into AI query routing. The screen agrees this is a trade rather than a thesis: score_thesis 40.7, the lowest in this batch, with a weakness score of 11 of 100.
bear_points: The capex bill has already broken free cash flow: FY2026 capex 143,251m RMB (up 55% YoY) turned FCF from +84,059m RMB to -59,146m RMB, and TTM FCF is -55,280m RMB (-7,087m USD), a -2.45% FCF yield.

Margins are paying for it: the operating margin fell from 14.07% (FY2025) to 5.04% (FY2026) even as gross margin rose from 39.74% to 40.99%, and the June-2026 quarter Non-GAAP net profit fell 38% YoY to 20.7bn RMB (长江证券 2026-09-22).

The offsetting story has no near-term earnings: the 20GW 2032 data-centre target, the 1,700bn USD implied external cloud revenue and the Zhenwu V900 chip shipping in 2027Q1 (中信证券 2026-09-23; 招商证券 2026-09-22) are all beyond the next two reported years, while UBS models FY27 capex at 230bn RMB (2026-09-22).

Regulatory event risk is live rather than theoretical: a reported CAC examination of whether DeepSeek and Moonshot routed queries to Claude, with Alibaba among five firms summoned, took the stock down about 3.7-4% on 2026-09-23 (X, @VestExchange and @davidmoadel), and the sweep separately notes a competition-law probe plus securities-litigation filings against the name (@MapleLeafWealth, 2026-09-21).

The bear framing with the most engagement on X is a multi-year de-rating, not a quarter: the value-trap post grouping Alibaba at -65% and JD at -75% drew 141 likes and 71k views (@LongGameEquity, 2026-09-05), and one account is short the China complex via YINN and KWEB after abandoning a BABA long (@HyenukChu, 2026-09-16).
risks_to_short: This is a trading short at best. Revenue is still growing +15.3% YoY on a TTM basis, Alibaba Cloud external revenue grew 45% with adjusted EBITA up 133% to 5.6bn RMB, and every one of the 12 sell-side documents in the bundle is constructive - UBS calls it the top China internet pick with a 206 target (2026-09-22) and 华泰 has 180.8 (2026-09-22).

The FCF gap is a capex peak, not a broken model: management told investors it can break even on AI-related capex in three years (@Beth_Kindig, 2026-08-26), and the AI cloud numbers are accelerating rather than fading - AI-related revenue has grown triple digits for twelve consecutive quarters (长江证券 2026-09-22).

There is no dilution leg and the valuation cushion is real: share count is down 13.8% YoY on buybacks, the stock is at 1.87x book and 13.9x forward earnings, and short interest is 2.58% of shares outstanding with a 1.37bn USD ADT, so there is no crowded short to unwind and no squeeze to fuel.

The bear case is a valuation observation unless capex keeps compounding: at a 289bn USD market cap, EPS growth of 61% for the year and a 200-week moving average cited as support (@TheLongInvest, 2026-09-10), any moderation in capex guidance re-rates the equity faster than the thesis can adapt.
catalysts: Q2 FY2027 results, with UBS modelling FY27 capex at 230bn RMB (2026-09-22) - the number that decides whether FCF stays negative.
The reported CAC AI probe involving five firms including Alibaba (X, 2026-09-23) and the outcome of the competition-law and securities-litigation matters flagged on X.
Cloud and chip milestones: Zhenwu V900 mass production and sale in 2027Q1, M890 supernode deployment, and Qwen 4.5/Qwen 5 at 5-10T parameters (中信建投 2026-09-23; 中金公司 2026-09-23).
The 2032 20GW data-centre commitment and any financing plan attached to it, against 380bn RMB of announced compute investment (国金证券 2026-09-23).

The bear-relevant content is in the numbers they report rather than their ratings: capex up, FCF negative, Non-GAAP profit down 38% YoY in the June-2026 quarter.

theses.name: HUTCHMED (China) Limited
theses.one_liner: HCM's 83% TTM net margin is a disposal artifact: the underlying business ran a -7.1% operating margin and burned RMB 503m, and a 39% three-month re-rate rests on one preclinical GSK deal.
theses.thesis: The recent move is a single-asset re-rating: on 3 Sep HUTCHMED out-licensed preclinical HMPL-A830 (a KRAS-EGFR ATTC) to GSK for 110m upfront and up to 1.185bn in milestones, and the stock is up 39.3% in three months and 10.2% in one. The screens' headline profitability is not repeatable: TTM net income of RMB 3.56bn on RMB 4.50bn of revenue, an 83% net margin, reflects the 2025 H1 Shanghai Hutchmed disposal - 广发证券 notes H1-26 attributable profit fell 96.5% yoy precisely because of that one-off - while the operating margin is -7.1%, TTM operating cash flow is -RMB 503m and free cash flow -RMB 613m. X's own bear path is that the platform does not repeat and the stock gives back the GSK pop. The problem for the short is mechanics: the US line trades about 1.2m a day, only 201,005 shares are short, and the screen marks it thin and restricted.
bear_points: Headline earnings are non-recurring: TTM net income of RMB 3.56bn, an 83% net margin, is the 2025 H1 Shanghai Hutchmed disposal gain; 广发证券 (20 Aug) shows H1-26 attributable profit down 96.5% yoy to 15.9m for exactly that reason, with an operating margin of -7.1%.

The business still burns cash: TTM operating cash flow -RMB 503m and free cash flow -RMB 613m (-78.6m), flagged as a cash burner; EV of 2.53bn now exceeds the 2.51bn market cap, so the net-cash cushion has gone.

The re-rating rests on one preclinical asset: HMPL-A830 is preclinical with a global Phase 1 targeted for 2H26 (西部证券, 华泰证券), and the economics are 110m upfront plus up to 1.185bn of milestones - the X bear path is that a platform which does not repeat gives back the GSK gain.
Valuation already reflects the deal: 4.35x TTM sales for a company whose oncology and immunology revenue grew 13% in H1-26 (广发证券), with the stock up 39.3% in three months and 10.2% in one.
The position cannot be sized: the US ADR trades about 1.2m a day, only 201,005 shares are short, the screen flags it thin and T3 restricted, and there is no float data.
risks_to_short: The news flow is against the short: the GSK license worth up to 1.295bn (3 Sep), SANOVO Phase 3 hitting PFS for savolitinib plus osimertinib in 1L EGFRm/MET+ NSCLC (UBS, 31 Aug), FDA approval of lirafugratinib in FGFR2+ cholangiocarcinoma (X, 23 Sep), and an HSBC upgrade to Buy at 260p from 175p (8 Sep).

Capitalisation: 国金证券 (2 Sep) cites HKD 10.79bn of cash and short-term investments, materially above the Hong Kong market capitalisation, with Deutsche Bank at a 20.5 target, Citi at HK 39 and UBS at HK 29.5, all Buy.

Pipeline breadth is real: five ATTC molecules are targeted for clinical entry by 2027 (Deutsche Bank, 3 Sep), savolitinib is heading for an FDA filing (华泰证券), and fruquintinib global sales were 185m in H1-26 (+14%, with non-US up about 70%) - a second out-license breaks the one-off framing.

Mechanically the P&L will be driven by slippage, not the thesis: with only 201,005 shares short and about 1.2m of daily dollar volume, every new milestone or approval headline is a squeeze risk and exits are expensive.

theses.name: iQIYI, Inc. Class A
theses.one_liner: IQ is a 1.01 ADR with three years of falling revenue, gross margin down to 21.7%, +33% dilution and a Q3 guide of -8%; at 0.27x sales the option is AI cost cuts, not the base business.
theses.thesis: Bulls own the AI option: UBS (19 Aug) argues AI can cut content production cost 70% to 90% and keeps Buy with a 1.55 target, Q2 content-distribution revenue rose 56% yoy, overseas member revenue rose 40%, and management targets sustainable adjusted operating breakeven in Q3-26. The screen prices the base business: revenue fell from RMB 31.9bn in FY23 to 26.6bn in FY25 with gross margin down to 21.7%, operating cash flow collapsed from RMB 3.35bn to 0.10bn, and TTM free cash flow was USD 3.8m. Nomura models Q3-26 revenue down another 8%, the ADR closed at 1.01, and share count is up 33.3% yoy.
bear_points: Three consecutive years of revenue decline: RMB 31.89bn (FY23) to 29.64bn (FY24) to 26.56bn (FY25), with TTM revenue -4.4% yoy; Nomura (19 Aug) models Q3-26 revenue down another 8% to about RMB 6.1bn.
Gross margin is decaying, not stabilising: 27.5% (FY23) to 24.5% (FY24) to 21.7% (FY25) - the AI content-cost saving is not yet visible in the reported P&L.
Cash generation has collapsed: operating cash flow RMB 3.35bn (FY23) to 2.14bn (FY24) to 0.10bn (FY25); TTM free cash flow was USD 3.8m on RMB 25.8bn of revenue, a 0.1% margin.

Dilution and the tape: share count +33.3% yoy with heavy-dilution and broken-tape flags, and the ADR closed at 1.01; an X post with about 606k views (22 Sep) explicitly raises Nasdaq's minimum-bid delisting risk.

The screen and the narrative disagree on the balance sheet: the screen's EV (2.48bn) exceeds market cap (994m), implying roughly 1.49bn of net debt, while 广发证券 (19 Aug) reports RMB 4.2bn of quarter-end net cash. The screen carries no net-cash flag either way, so the bear case cannot lean on a cash cushion.
risks_to_short: The AI option is concrete: UBS (19 Aug) sees a 70% to 90% cut in content production cost and keeps Buy at 1.55; 东方证券 (24 Sep) counts 350-plus titles at the iJoy event with the first AI seasonal drama in Q4; 华泰证券 keeps Buy at 1.91.
Operating breakeven is guided for Q3-26 with a 2027 revenue recovery (Citi, 3 Sep), and Q2-26 operating cash flow was already positive at RMB 340m with RMB 4.2bn of reported net cash (广发证券).

The stock is priced for a broken business: 0.27x sales, 0.53x book, a 994m market cap and 7.74% short interest, so a single content hit or an acceleration in overseas (Brazil +215%, Mexico +150% yoy) re-rates it violently.
Buybacks and the 1.01 bid mean the mechanical risk is upward: 21.8m ADS repurchased for USD 24.1m (广发证券; HSBC), and a sub-1bn-cap streaming asset is a plausible strategic or private-equity target.

theses.name: Bilibili Inc. Class Z
theses.one_liner: Bilibili is priced at 27x EV/EBITDA for a game-cycle story while mobile games fell 14% in 2Q26 and the equity carries a new 700m USD zero-coupon convertible.
theses.thesis: The market is buying the advertising franchise plus a promised game recovery: 2Q26 advertising revenue rose 28% to 3.13bn RMB, now 39% of revenue and the largest line (国信证券, 2026-09-01), and J.P.Morgan has made Bilibili its China digital-entertainment top pick with a 22 USD target on the expectation that game revenue turns positive in 4Q26 and grows 22% in 2027. The screen says the current multiple already assumes that recovery: 28.3x TTM earnings, 27.3x EV/EBITDA and 13.9x forward, on a 4.87% TTM net margin. In the same quarter the reported revenue grew only 8% and mobile games fell 14% to about 1.4bn RMB, with the offset being advertising growth that 东方证券 expects to decelerate from +28% to +24% in 3Q26. The gap closes if the new titles underperform the 10-15亿元 annualised run-rate the bulls ascribe to them, because the advertising line alone does not support a 27x EV/EBITDA multiple on a company earning 153m RMB per quarter.
bear_points: The profit base is thin against the multiple: TTM net income 1,526m RMB on 31,222m RMB revenue (net margin 4.89%) and 2Q26 adjusted net profit of 704m RMB (+25% YoY) with an 8.9% net margin (国信证券, 2026-09-01), against TTM P/E 28.3x and EV/EBITDA 27.26x.

Gaming is still shrinking in the quarter the market calls the new cycle: mobile game revenue fell 14% YoY to about 1.4bn RMB, on which 东方证券 (2026-09-03) models 3Q26 game revenue of about 1.4bn RMB, still -7% YoY.

Advertising growth is expected to decelerate: 东方证券 models 3Q26 advertising revenue of 3.2bn RMB, +24% versus +28% in 2Q26, and 高盛 (2026-09-03) frames the ad-load ceiling as a long-run story (about 7% rising to 10%+) rather than a near-term step-change.

The capital structure is being rebuilt around the recovery: a 700m USD zero-coupon convertible due 2031 at a 155.79 HKD conversion price (about 35% premium) with Tencent subscribing 200m USD, plus a 300m USD buyback, nets about 3.5% dilution (Nomura, 2026-09-07; Citi, 2026-09-06) - dilution is being issued at a level the stock has not traded near.

The tape disagrees with the narrative: -38.5% over six months, -44.8% over twelve months and -39.8% YTD, with 21.997m shares short (7.03% of a 298m share float) already positioned - the squeeze is priced in, and the rebound is instead being defended by option flow that the sweep classifies as bullish-to-neutral rather than directional.
risks_to_short: J.P.Morgan has made this its top pick in China digital entertainment with Overweight and a 22 USD target on both the US and HK lines, arguing Tencent's exit removed the selling overhang and that the game cycle starting September 2026 lifts revenue growth to +22% in 2027 (@JPM, 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-18) - a hit new title would invalidate the whole thesis.

The buyback and convertible are a structural bid: a 700m USD zero-coupon 2031 convertible with Tencent taking 200m USD, plus a 300m USD repurchase, leaves cash and equivalents of 24.3bn RMB (国信证券, 2026-09-01) and 高盛 (2026-09-03) says cash flow comfortably supports shareholder returns.

Sell-side is broadly constructive: Citi Buy at 27 USD, HSBC Buy at 23.5 USD, Goldman Buy at 27.7 USD (75%+ upside), J.P.Morgan 22 USD, 中信建投 and 东方证券 constructive, with only Nomura at Neutral and 18 USD - five buy ratings create a reflexive bid into any game-launch data point.

Supply removal is real: Tencent exited its 9.6% stake in an orderly conversion-plus-placement and the sweep records institutions defending the low with unusual volume, so there is no visible seller left - and 7.03% short interest on a 6.4bn USD market cap is fuel for a squeeze on positive title data.
catalysts: Post-launch data for 《闪耀吧！噜咪》 (Lumi Master), which J.P.Morgan expects to be worth 10-15亿元 of annual revenue - if momentum holds it is the bull trigger.
《三国志：王道天下》 guided for Q4 2026 (中信建投, 2026-09-16) - the next hard test of the game-cycle claim.
3Q26 advertising revenue versus 东方证券's 3.2bn RMB / +24% estimate, the first deceleration print.
Registration and conversion of the 700m USD zero-coupon 2031 convertible at 155.79 HKD and completion of the 300m USD buyback.
4Q26, when J.P.Morgan expects game revenue growth to turn positive - the single cleanest falsifier of this short.

theses.name: NIO Inc. Class A
theses.one_liner: NIO's non-GAAP profit is a 24.8m RMB rounding error on 32.1bn RMB of quarterly revenue, and the screen shows the runway story rests on cash while the equity has fallen 47.6% in a year.
theses.thesis: The bull case is the inflection: Q2 2026 adjusted net profit turned positive at 2.07亿元 (中信建投, 2026-09-15), gross margin reached 18.4% (+8.4pts YoY), and Morgan Stanley (2026-09-17) sees group vehicle margin holding ~18% and cash exceeding 600亿元 by year-end. The screen says the inflection is arithmetic-thin: TTM net loss is 4,735m RMB against TTM operating cash flow of +2,913m RMB and TTM FCF of -3,156m RMB, so the company still consumes cash, and quarterly GAAP net margin is still negative (-2.25% in 2Q26). Non-GAAP quarterly profit of 24.8m RMB (国盛证券, 2026-09-07) is 0.08% of revenue - it cannot absorb a 100bp adverse move in vehicle margin. The gap closes if the Q3/Q4 delivery step-up to 108-111k and then 40k/month does not arrive, because the fixed cost of swap stations, three brands and the chip programme is already in the run-rate.
bear_points: The 'profit' is de minimis: 2Q26 non-GAAP net profit of 24.81m RMB (0.25亿元) and adjusted net profit of 207m RMB on 32.14bn RMB revenue, with GAAP net loss of 722m RMB - 华兴证券 (2026-09-07) also notes the non-GAAP figure fell 44.3% QoQ.

Cash is still leaving the business: TTM operating cash flow +2,913m RMB but TTM capex 6,068m RMB gives TTM FCF of -3,156m RMB (FCF margin -2.8%), and FY2025 FCF was -3,156m RMB after -17,102m RMB in FY2024.

Margin resides in two halo models: HSBC (2026-09-15) attributes the 18.5% vehicle margin to high-margin ES8/ES9 demand; the mass-market ONVO and Firefly volume is what carries the Q4 40k/month target.

Guidance and TPs are being cut, not raised: Goldman Sachs (2026-09-04) cut its TP to 48 HKD from 55 on below-expectation 3Q26 volume and revenue guidance; HSBC cut to 6.4 USD from 7 and trimmed 2026 volume 10% to 431k units; 华兴证券 cut to 4.30 USD with a Hold; J.P.Morgan downgraded to Neutral at 4.50 USD (2026-09-02).

The equity has not been rewarded for the story: -47.6% over 12 months, -21.8% over 1 month, -29.0% YTD, with 129.99m shares short (4.48% of float) already in place - so the short is neither novel nor obviously squeezable.
risks_to_short: Delivery ramp is real if it holds: 2Q26 deliveries of 107.7k (+49.4% YoY) with the NIO brand at 60.9k, and the Q3 guide of 108-111k implies 332.9-340.5亿元 of revenue (华兴证券, 2026-09-07) - hitting the Q4 40k/month target converts the operating leverage story.

Liquidity stack is the explicit bear-killer: @NIOSwitzerland (2026-09-07) puts NIO liquidity at about 8.4bn USD, up from the 2025 trough, and 光大证券 (2026-09-02) reports 567亿元 of cash in hand plus 230元 of per-vehicle profit; @_mm85 (2026-09-02, 251 likes / 15.2k views) argues the runway went from '3 quarters to up to 80 quarters', directly refuting the cash-runway short.

Sell-side is not uniformly negative: Morgan Stanley has Overweight on the H-shares at 68.5 HKD (2026-09-17) and 58 HKD (2026-09-03) with a 2027-2028 volume growth case of 40-50% per year, and HSBC and Goldman both keep Buy ratings despite cutting targets.

Short interest is used as a bull argument, not a confirmation: @totoshkatrades (2026-09-17) frames the 130m share short as squeeze fuel, and the sweep notes NIO bulls treat high SI plus a Wyckoff 'spring' as an entry (@BullBearSignals, 2026-09-21, 49 likes / 4.3k views) - a delivery beat would squeeze a heavily shorted, retail-owned tape.
catalysts: Q3 2026 deliveries against the 108-111k guide and the Q3 print - the first look at whether the 18.5% vehicle margin holds as ONVO/Firefly mix rises.
The Q4 2026 target of more than 40k units per month, which management set and 国盛证券 and 西部证券 both repeat.
Any Chinese EV price-war escalation - the X sweep names it as the kill switch for the margin story (@xCrypto_Rocket, 2026-09-01).
Onvo/L60 and Firefly volume cadence, where the margin is thinnest but the units are needed.

x_sentiment.lean: Retail bulls dominate the volume while bears exist but are thin and low-engagement; short interest is being used as squeeze fuel rather than as confirmation of a working short.
x_sentiment.notes: The X sweep is the five-name EV batch (NIO, XPEV, LI, PONY, WRD) and rates NIO 'Strong (volume)' on chatter but with bears 'thin'. Morgan Stanley is the loud bull (Overweight, 58-68.5 HKD), while J.P.Morgan downgraded to Neutral at 4.50 USD and 华兴证券 has Hold at 4.30 USD; Goldman, HSBC, 招银国际 and Bernstein all cut targets in September 2026 while keeping Buy/Market-Perform. The shared worry across the notes is third-quarter guidance and SG&A, not the balance sheet.

theses.name: PDD Holdings Inc. Class A
theses.one_liner: PDD's two domestic engines both stalled in 2Q26 - ad revenue +3.5%, commissions +13% - as Temu global MAU fell 15% and downloads fell 44%, while adjusted net profit fell 13%.
theses.thesis: The market owns PDD as the cheapest large-cap China internet asset: 8.66x TTM earnings, 7.19x forward, 1.54x EV/Sales, 15.4bn USD of TTM free cash flow and a 13.5% FCF yield, with the X crowd framing it as 'the market is either giving this away or pricing in something ugly'. The screen and the sell-side show the ugly part arriving together. 2Q26 revenue grew 8.1% with online marketing services up 3.5% and transaction services up 13% (from +20% in 1Q26), and non-GAAP net profit fell 12.9% to 28.5bn RMB with the adjusted net margin down 6.1pts YoY to 25.4%. Internationally, Temu's global MAU fell 15% YoY to 468m and global monthly downloads fell 44% to 21.2m, with only the US growing, just as the EU removed the 150-euro de-minimis exemption in July 2026. The gap closes if domestic monetisation keeps decelerating while Temu's unit model is repriced by tariffs - the cash pile delays the re-rating, it does not prevent it.
bear_points: Both domestic engines slowed in the same quarter: 2Q26 revenue 112.36bn RMB (+8.05%), with online marketing services +3.5% to 57.64bn RMB and transaction services +13.3% to 54.72bn RMB versus +20% in 1Q26 - the commission line missed and 中信建投 attributes it to Temu and the US de-minimis change (中信建投 2026-08-31; 国海证券 2026-08-27; X post @VulcanMK5, 2026-09-02).

Profit is shrinking, not just growing slower: non-GAAP net profit 28.49bn RMB, -12.9% YoY, with the adjusted net margin down 6.1pts YoY to 25.4%, and quarterly GAAP net margin printed 11.81% in 1Q26 - the weakest quarter in the screen's series (国海证券; 东吴证券, 2026-08-27).

Temu's audience is contracting, not just decelerating: Morgan Stanley (2026-09-08) reports global MAU -15% YoY to 468m and global monthly downloads -44% to 21.2m in August 2026, with only the US up (+9% YoY) while Europe and LatAm fell.

The EU removed the 150-euro de-minimis exemption from July 2026, which 国证国际 (2026-08-26) says is pressuring the low-price small-parcel model, and Barclays (2026-08-25) reports Temu GMV growth of about 20% in 2Q26 versus 38-60% in the prior five quarters - a step-down, not a wobble.

Even the bulls are trimming: J.P.Morgan assumed coverage at Neutral and cut its target to 95 USD from 110 on slower domestic monetisation and Temu regulatory uncertainty, and HSBC cut to 140 from 144 while keeping Buy - the direction of estimate revisions is down across the board.
risks_to_short: Balance sheet: about 50bn USD of cash against a 114bn USD market cap (X post @Quality_stocksA, 2026-09-20, 5.5k views), and the screen shows TTM FCF of 109,716m RMB - a 13.5% FCF yield - so the company can fund the reinvestment cycle indefinitely and every year of delay accrues cash.

Valuation is genuinely low even on the bear numbers: 8.66x TTM P/E and 7.19x forward, 1.77x P/S and 1.54x EV/Sales; both J.P.Morgan at 95 USD (Neutral) and Barclays at 89 USD (Equal Weight) have targets above the 79.20 close, so the Street's bear case is still upside.

Domestic stabilisation is the bulls' documented read: HSBC (2026-08-25) titled its note 'domestic growth appears to have stabilized' and 国泰海通 (2026-09-09) called the quarter basically in line with 2026E revenue of 471.7bn RMB - if the ad line re-accelerates off the +3.5% base the multiple has nowhere to go but up.

The crowd is long, so the short pays for the crowd's patience: X carries a contrarian-long/value debate with @LowAlphaHighVol (2026-09-19, 188 likes / 39k views) explicitly shorting Sea against a long PDD, and only 4.32% of float short; the screen flags 'no float data', so sizing and borrow risk are unknown going in.
catalysts: 3Q26 results and the next read on online marketing services growth off the +3.5% base - the single cleanest falsifier of this thesis.
Q4 holiday season and the Double 11 read on domestic commission take-rate and the 100bn RMB merchant support programme.
EU tariff and DSA enforcement milestones on Temu, plus 中信证券(香港)'s note that Temu GMV was roughly flat QoQ in 2Q26 under the new EU tariff regime.
Launch of the '新拼姆' self-operated brand on Temu, guided for 3Q26 (国证国际, 2026-08-26) - a margin-mix risk if it scales.

Continued share gains by ByteDance/Douyin in domestic e-commerce, which a reply on the largest PDD bear post names as the reason a cash-rich incumbent can still be outspent (@hbwh2k24, quoted in @truetrue2355's 13 Sep 2026 thread).

theses.name: Tencent Music Entertainment Group Class A
theses.one_liner: Tencent Music is priced at 9.7x earnings for a business whose reported +5.8% growth is entirely bought - organic music revenue grew 1.6% in 2Q26 while social entertainment fell 16.4%.
theses.thesis: The market reads TME as a cheap defensive compounder: 9.7x TTM earnings, 2.5x EV/Sales, a 26.3% net margin, a 32.3% FCF margin and net cash-like liquidity, down 64.8% over a year and 51.2% YTD. Underneath, the growth is inorganic. 2Q26 revenue of 8.92bn RMB rose 5.8% only because Himalaya contributed 407m RMB from 18 May 2026; strip that out and the business declined (中金公司, 2026-08-12, says non-IFRS net profit missed partly because music revenue ex-Himalaya was below forecast). Music revenue grew 11.0% with membership up only 8.1%, while social entertainment fell 16.4% to 1.328bn RMB, and management guided conservatively. The mechanism is a competitive share loss to ByteDance that compresses both the subscriber funnel and the ad pool at once; the 9.7x multiple is therefore a bet on organic re-acceleration that no published note models.
bear_points: Organic growth is roughly zero: music revenue +11.0% to 7.605bn RMB in 2Q26 including 407m RMB of Himalaya consolidation; non-IFRS net profit of 2.686bn RMB grew only 4.4% and missed 中金公司's forecast specifically because ex-Himalaya music revenue fell short (中金公司, 2026-08-12).
The legacy profit pool is shrinking: social entertainment and other revenue fell 16.4% YoY to 1.328bn RMB, and 中金公司 warns the competitive shock hits the traffic base, dragging advertising as well.

Earnings estimates are being cut with the target prices: Nomura downgraded to Neutral and cut its TP to 10 USD from 12.5 (2026-08-12), UBS cut to 9.5 from 13 (Neutral), HSBC to 10 from 10.6 (Hold), J.P.Morgan to 9 USD with 2026 adjusted net profit held at 9.8bn RMB, and 光大证券 cut FY2026-2028 adjusted net profit to 9.9/11.0/11.9bn RMB.

The screen's cheapness is partly optical: the 'broken tape' flag with a -64.8% one-year return and -51.2% YTD reflects a market already de-rating the franchise, and 中金公司 reports gross margin fell 0.7pt QoQ to 44.2% with operating expenses expected to rise in 2H26 on Himalaya marketing and possible restructuring.

Growth of the acquired asset is not verified: management's '100bn RMB-scale revenue in 5-10 years' ambition for concert merchandise and derivatives (Goldman Sachs, 2026-09-02) is a decade-long claim being used to justify today's multiple, and the one quantified new-business contribution is Himalaya's 400m RMB.
risks_to_short: It is cheap on cash, not on hope: 9.7x TTM P/E, 9.07x forward, 7.15x EV/EBITDA, P/B 1.11x, with 11,179m RMB TTM operating cash flow, 10,874m RMB TTM FCF and a 153m USD-equivalent FCF yield of 11.9% - the short is a de-rating trade, not a solvency trade.

Shareholder returns are real and accelerating: 4亿美元 of buybacks completed in 2Q26 against a 10亿美元 programme running to March 2027 (中金公司, 2026-08-12), 442.2亿元 of cash and equivalents (国信证券, 2026-08-17), and Goldman Sachs (2026-08-12) frames buyback plus dividend as roughly a 10% total shareholder yield.

The competitive damage may be less bad than feared: J.P.Morgan (2026-08-16) says 2Q26 membership deterioration was better than market worries, and SVIP members passed 20m with ARPU around 20元 (Goldman Sachs, 2026-09-02) - monetisation of the top tier is still working.

Himalaya optionality plus a beaten-down chart: the stock is near a 70% drawdown with a contrarian long setup flagged on X (@ChartCodex, 2026-09-13, base plus 340%), and Goldman remains Buy at 11.7 USD - a re-rating on any organic stabilisation would be violent on a 9.7x base.
catalysts: 3Q26 results - 中金公司 models membership revenue +8.5% YoY, the first clean read on competition after the 2H launch of ByteDance-backed competition.
2H26 operating expense line, which 中金公司 expects to rise on Himalaya re-investment and possible organisational changes.
Himalaya integration milestones - the 1.5-month contribution of about 400m RMB is the only quantified diversification so far (Goldman Sachs, 2026-09-02).
Buyback pace against the remaining portion of the 10亿美元 authorisation expiring March 2027.
Any pricing or bundling move by ByteDance's music product, which UBS and Nomura both name as the share-loss driver.

theses.one_liner: MicroCloud Hologram burns cash at a 1.0-year runway while the screen's own EV field and net-cash flag disagree by an order of magnitude on how much cash it holds.
theses.thesis: The bull case is a cash shell: X promo accounts cite a 6-K showing cash plus short-term investments of about USD 374m, short-term investments of RMB 1.80bn, 140,268 MSTR shares and a roughly 90% book-value discount, against a USD 40.8m market cap - and the screen's EV of USD -222.3m is at least directionally consistent with a very large investment book. The bear mechanism is the operating side and the marks: TTM operating cash flow of -21.2m and free cash flow of -21.3m against a USD 40.8m market cap with a 1.0-year runway, TTM revenue of 43.6m against a TTM net loss of 29.1m (-66.7% net margin), and a customer book the cited 6-K puts at 17 customers for 99.1% of revenue. The honest caveat is that the bundle cannot settle the cash line - net_cash_pct_mcap says 49.9% of market cap (about USD 20m) while the EV field implies roughly USD 263m of net cash - and a thesis whose own cash figure is off by an order of magnitude is a governance question, not a clean solvency short.
bear_points: Self-funding failure: TTM operating cash flow -21.2m and free cash flow -21.3m (a -52.1% FCF yield) against a USD 40.8m market cap and a 1.0-year runway (runway<2y flag), with TTM revenue of 43.6m and a TTM net loss of 29.1m (-66.7% net margin).

The burn is recent, not chronic: FY2025 operating cash flow was positive at +7.84m on revenue of 56.2m (FY2024 40.3m, FY2023 28.9m, FY2022 72.5m) while the TTM window is -21.2m, so the deterioration sits in the four quarters after the last annual report in the bundle (27 Mar 2026).

The flag and the annuals disagree and the bundle cannot arbitrate: the screen's revenue-collapse flag carries a rev_yoy of -72.8% while annual revenue rose to 56.2m in FY2025 from 40.3m in FY2024, and the 6-K quoted by X shows 17 customers at 99.1% of revenue - with the quarterly series ending in 2023.

The bull case is an asset-book claim the bundle cannot verify, and the screen's own fields disagree by an order of magnitude: net_cash_pct_mcap of 49.9% (about USD 20m) versus an EV of USD -222.3m (implying roughly USD 263m of net cash), against X's cited figures of about USD 374m of cash plus short-term investments and RMB 1.80bn of short-term investments.

Short mechanics are unattractive: the screen's shortability score is 29.6/100, joint-lowest in this batch, with conviction 48.2 alongside a 'net cash >40% mcap' flag, SI is 2.48% of a 22.30m float (1,178,644 shares), ADT is only USD 0.59m, beta is 2.899, and the borrow component scores 90/100 - uncrowded and unassisted.
risks_to_short: If the investment book is real, the equity trades far below it: a claimed USD 374m of cash plus short-term investments, or the EV-implied roughly USD 263m of net cash, against a USD 40.8m market cap is exactly the mechanical situation the 'net cash >40% mcap' flag describes, and X bulls already trade it as a book-value discount with 140,268 MSTR shares.

The bear case rests on an unverifiable cash line and a stale quarterly series: the bundle's quarterly cash-flow data end in 2023, so the -21.2m TTM burn cannot be tied to a specific period and a single 6-K or 20-F could invalidate the operating read.

Squeeze mechanics are live: a 22.30m float, 2.48% SI, ADT of only USD 0.59m and an unsourced 'short squeeze into Sep 24 earnings' campaign are the classic setup for a violent move against a short, and at USD 1.70 after a -99.98% three-year decline the convexity of any asset verification (stake sale, buyback or distribution) is large relative to the short's remaining downside.

Zero coverage cuts both ways: there is no estimate to miss and no broker to force a re-rate, so nothing in the bundle schedules a resolution of the cash-line question - the short can be right and unpaid for several quarters.
catalysts: Next filing: the bundle records a 2025年报 (27 Mar 2026) and a 盈利预告 (4 Sep 2025), so the next 6-K/annual report is the event that would settle the cash-line question.
Quarterly cash-flow disclosure, which the bundle's series has not carried since 2023 - the 1.0-year runway puts the funding decision inside four quarters.
Any monetisation or revaluation of the investment book (short-term investments, the 140,268 MSTR shares) - the substance of the bull case in the X threads.

theses.name: Trip.com Group Ltd.
theses.one_liner: Trip.com's 5.18bn RMB SAMR penalty is not the whole cost - the commission-to-advertising model shift and a domestic travel decline that brokers expect to persist through 4Q26 are the durable drag.
theses.thesis: The bull case is that Trip.com is a 6.3x trailing-earnings asset with 50%+ international growth and 100.5bn RMB of cash, and that the antitrust matter is now behind it. The screen says the domestic engine is contracting while international growth is not yet large enough to carry the group: 中信证券(香港) (2026-09-18) reports domestic travel revenue down mid-single digits with outbound decelerating to mid-single digits and expects the pressure to persist into 4Q26, while 国信证券 cut its 2026 domestic revenue forecast from +2.5% to -0.6%. The regulatory cost is not purely one-time either - the same note says the shift from a commission model to commission-plus-advertising will compress the take rate, after a 5.18bn RMB charge in 2Q26 sent GAAP net income to -2.46bn RMB. International OTA revenue grew 50%+ but 中信证券 puts adjusted EBIT down 6.5% YoY, so the growth is not yet accretive to group profit.
bear_points: Domestic demand is shrinking and guided to keep shrinking: 中信证券(香港) (2026-09-18) says domestic travel revenue fell mid-single digits in 2Q26, outbound growth slowed to mid-single digits, and expects domestic revenue to decline mid-single digits again in 3Q26 with pressure continuing into 4Q26; 国信证券 cut its 2026 domestic revenue forecast from +2.5% to -0.6%.

The penalty is large and the model change is structural: a 5.18bn RMB SAMR antitrust charge in 2Q26 turned GAAP net income to -2.46bn RMB (华创证券, 2026-09-24; 招商证券, 2026-09-23), and 中信证券(香港) says the move from commission to commission-plus-advertising will lower the short-term take rate.

Profit is already falling before the penalty optics: adjusted EBIT of 4.4bn RMB was down 6.5% YoY (中信证券, 2026-09-18), non-GAAP net income of 4.80bn RMB was down 4.3% YoY (招商证券; 华泰证券), and Nomura (2026-09-16) says the 6% revenue growth and the international loss narrowing are 'not enough to offset the domestic drag'.

Segment mix is deteriorating: transportation ticketing revenue fell 1% YoY to 5.4bn RMB while accommodation grew only 6% to 6.6bn RMB in 2Q26 (华创证券 2026-09-24; 国联民生 2026-09-20; 申万宏源 2026-09-18) - the two largest segments are barely growing.

theses.one_liner: Not shortable: H World raised 2026 revenue guidance, grew Q2 adjusted net profit 26.9%, yields 8.5% on free cash flow and carries no screen flags at all.
theses.thesis: The finding here is the absence of a thesis. Q2 2026 revenue was RMB 7,121m (+10.8% YoY) with managed-and-franchised revenue of RMB 3,586m (+25.2%), adjusted net profit of RMB 1,712m (+26.9%) and adjusted EBITDA of RMB 2,725m (+20.0%); management raised full-year revenue guidance to +4-8% and M&F guidance to +16-20% (中信建投 2026-08-27, 国海证券 2026-09-04). TTM free cash flow was RMB 8,826.5m (USD 1,131.6m), an 8.52% FCF yield, and the company committed USD 2.5bn of shareholder returns over three years with a first dividend of USD 275m. The honest bear case is narrow: overseas (HWI) RevPAR of USD 98 was -3.8% YoY and net store openings of 322 were -29% YoY. That is not enough against a 15.5x forward multiple and a committed capital-return programme, so the correct action is to pass.
bear_points: Domestic RevPAR growth is nominal, not volume-driven: HWC RevPAR of RMB 238 was +1.1% YoY, made up of ADR +2.6% with occupancy -1.2pct (东方财富 2026-08-25) - pricing is carrying the number.

Reported profit growth lagged operating growth: Q2 2026 attributable net profit rose only 2.1% YoY against +10.8% revenue and +26.9% adjusted net profit, on FX losses (国盛证券 2026-09-02).
Nothing in the screen supports a short: no flags, weakness 0.0, revenue +17.65% YoY, TTM net margin 18.93%, dilution -1.55% (buybacks), FCF yield 8.52%.
risks_to_short: Everything that would break a short is already in place: guidance raised, all twelve sell-side documents in the bundle constructive, a USD 2.5bn three-year capital-return plan with a USD 275m first dividend, and an 8.52% TTM free cash flow yield on RMB 8,826.5m.

theses.name: JD.com, Inc. Class A
theses.one_liner: JD's re-rating is a subsidy-withdrawal trade: Q2-26 revenue fell 2.9% and 1P electronics 11.8%, while 6.6x NTM earnings need new-business losses to keep narrowing on a lever 华泰 calls diminishing.
theses.thesis: The market is paying 6.6x NTM earnings for a margin recovery: FY2025 operating margin collapsed to 0.22% from 3.3% and operating cash flow to RMB 18.5bn from 58.9bn as food-delivery investment hit, and Q2-26 revenue still fell 2.9% yoy to about RMB 346bn with 1P electronics down 11.8%. 中信证券 and 招银国际 read the quarter as a profit rebound driven by narrower delivery losses; 华泰证券 argues the narrowing rests on a single subsidy lever with diminishing returns and that JD is a late entrant far below the order scale needed to compete. All twelve recent sell-side documents are Buy with targets of 38 to 48 against a 27.16 close, which makes this a trading short on loss-narrowing disappointment rather than a structural one.
bear_points: Core revenue is shrinking: Q2-26 revenue -2.9% yoy to about RMB 346bn with 1P electronics -11.8%, growth coming from general merchandise, healthcare and advertising (+8.3% to RMB 3.09bn) rather than the core (中信证券, 17 Aug; 招银国际, 14 Aug).
The FY2025 baseline shows how thin the core margin is: operating margin 0.22% versus 3.3% in FY2024 and operating cash flow RMB 18.5bn versus RMB 58.9bn, with Q4-25 net margin at -0.77%.

华泰证券 (15 Aug) says food-delivery loss reduction relies on one lever, subsidy contraction, with diminishing marginal effect, and that JD is a late entrant far from stable order scale; Q3 is peak season, so sequential losses may widen rather than narrow.

Event risk is live: an EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation remedy package for the EUR 2.2bn Ceconomy deal has a mid-October clock (X, 11 Sep), and the 23 Sep Beijing AI probe headlines hit JD alongside BABA and BIDU.
An accounting-quality question with no disclosure: X (9 Sep) flags food-delivery orders being split into sub-orders, which would flatter order growth and subsidy-per-order if counted separately.
risks_to_short: Balance sheet and cash generation make this a poor structural short: the screen puts EV at 30.4bn against a 38.1bn market cap with TTM FCF of 42.7bn (15.8% FCF yield), and UBS (16 Aug) goes further, claiming net cash is nearly half of market cap.

The recovery is already visible: Q2-26 adjusted EBIT rebounded to RMB 5.5bn (1.6% margin) with core retail operating margin at a quarterly-high 4.6% (UBS, 14 Aug), and management told Goldman (11 Sep) that JD Retail growth turned positive in Q3.

Consensus is unanimously long with rising numbers - Goldman Buy PT 43 (11 Sep), UBS Buy PT 48 (16 Aug), HSBC Buy PT 38 (4 Sep), Nomura Buy PT 41 (14 Aug), 招银国际 Buy PT 48.3 (14 Aug) - against a 27.16 close with only 3.88% short interest.

Joybuy, 京喜 and the advertising mix shift are real optionality, and delivery losses are guided to keep narrowing quarter by quarter; if that holds, the earnings-recovery multiple works and the short has no catalyst.

theses.name: KE Holdings, Inc. Class A
theses.one_liner: BEKE's profit elasticity is an 18% opex cut plus a revenue-recognition switch on a shrinking top line - FY25 free cash flow was negative -RMB 974m and insiders sold into the re-rating.
theses.thesis: The bull case is what the reported numbers show: H1-26 adjusted net income of RMB 4.8bn (+49.2%) on gross margin of 26.6% (+5.3pp), Q2 GTV +6.3% yoy for the first positive quarter after three negative ones, and J.P.Morgan calling BEKE a policy beneficiary at 14x 2026 earnings. The short case is composition. H1-26 revenue fell 12.0% while profit rose, because operating expenses dropped 18.0% yoy and the revenue basis shifted toward net-method platform services (东北证券). Underneath, FY2025 operating cash flow was -RMB 366m and free cash flow -RMB 974m, the agent network shrank 3.1% yoy to 541k, and national listing prices are still deflating at -0.56% in August (东方证券).
bear_points: FY2025 cash flow was negative - operating cash flow -RMB 366m and free cash flow -RMB 974m - so the 2026 profit elasticity is not accompanied by cash generation; the recovery is cost-led, with total operating expenses down 18.0% yoy (中信建投 and 中泰证券).

Reported revenue is no longer comparable: H1-26 revenue -12.0% to RMB 43.4bn while adjusted net income rose 49.2%; 东北证券 says the switch to the net method masks the underlying operating improvement and that mix shifted toward net-method platform services.

Housing fundamentals are still deflating: national listing prices -0.46% in July and -0.56% in August, with tier-2 at -0.60% and tier-3/4 at -0.55% (东方证券, 11 Sep); HSBC (4 Sep) quantifies that every 10% fall in new-home GTV takes 3% off profit, and new home is the higher-margin tie-in.

The network is shrinking even as share is gained: about 60,300 stores and 541k agents, with agents -3.1% yoy (中泰证券, 26 Aug).
risks_to_short: The operating inflection is real and broad: Q2-26 GTV of RMB 933.8bn (+6.3% yoy, +31.2% q/q) was the first positive quarter after three negative ones, gross margin reached 29% (+7pp yoy), and all four main businesses improved contribution margin (中信建投, 国信证券, 东北证券, 国海证券).

Policy is a tailwind, not a headwind: UBS (28 Aug) calls the new presale regime (presale only after topping-out, with escrowed proceeds) positive for BEKE, and J.P.Morgan (11 Sep) models 16% operating profit growth in 2027-28 as market share rises.

theses.one_liner: Huya burned RMB 339m of free cash flow in FY2025 and earns a 14.7% gross margin on a forced pivot, yet Citi, HSBC and BOC all rate it Buy with targets about double the price.
theses.thesis: Huya's story is a live-streaming platform converting into a game-services company, but the conversion is expensive and low-margin: FY2025 operating cash flow was RMB -171m and free cash flow RMB -339m, TTM free cash flow is -USD 47.8m, and the screen flags it a cash burner. Game-related revenue did grow 54% YoY in 2Q26 to 36.7% of revenue, but consolidated gross margin is only 14.7% and non-GAAP operating profit was RMB 16m on RMB 1.74bn of revenue (CICC, 2026-08-12). The mechanism is that the buyback-and-net-cash cushion is being spent on a marketing-heavy game pipeline, with 4Q25's RMB 66m streamer receivable provision showing the quality risk. With the Street at Buy and targets of 3.50-4.6 against a 2.32 close, this is a positioning short into a crowded long, not a consensus bear.
bear_points: Cash burn: FY2025 operating cash flow RMB -171m and free cash flow RMB -339m; TTM free cash flow -USD 47.8m with an FCF yield of -8.8% and a 'cash burner' screen flag.
Margins do not support the pivot: 2Q26 gross margin 14.7% and non-GAAP operating profit of only RMB 16m on revenue of RMB 1.74bn (CICC, 2026-08-12).

Pivot quality: Citi (2026-03-18) records a RMB 66m one-off receivable provision against a streamer in 4Q25, and CICC (2026-08-12) notes 2Q26 non-streaming revenue missed consensus by 3.6% on 鹅鸭杀 payment volatility.

The doubled buyback is not yet real money: the authorization went from USD 50m to USD 100m, but CICC says execution is slow (2026-08-12); 3Q26 marketing spend rises ahead of the 剑侠情缘：重逢 and 消消奇遇 launches.
Liquidity and borrow are thin: USD 3.1m ADT, T3 restricted, no float data, and only 2.33m shares short (1.24% of shares) - no crowded short to squeeze, but no depth for an exit either.
risks_to_short: Net cash: the screen's USD 446.5m EV against a USD 541.2m market cap implies about USD 95m of net cash (17% of cap), and X traders describe it as 'trading at NET cash' (@stonkgang, 21 Sep).

The Street is almost unanimously Buy and far above the price: Citi PT 4.6 (2026-08-12 and 2026-09-03), HSBC PT 4.5 (2026-05-29), BOC PT 3.50 (2026-05-13); Morgan Stanley is the only Equal-weight at 3.4.

The operating inflection is real: 2Q26 revenue +11% YoY, game-related revenue +54%, gross margin +1.2pt to 14.7%, operating loss narrowed to RMB 7m, and the buyback authorization doubled to USD 100m (CICC and Citi, 2026-08-12).
Launch option value: 剑侠情缘：重逢 and 消消奇遇 are due in late 3Q26 and the self-developed 这岛有幻兽 was approved in July 2026; X also floats an unverified AI companion product (@GeldSein83110, 14 Sep).
catalysts: 3Q26 results with the new game launches and a marketing step-up
Buyback execution against the USD 100m authorization
WeChat mini-game version of 鹅鸭杀
Any further streamer receivable provisions

x_sentiment.notes: The sweep labels HUYA sparse and says plainly it is a 52-week-low, net-cash long rather than a short: @stonkgang calls it an 'insane buy' at net cash, @GeldSein83110 floats a EUR 5 target and an AI companion product, and two posts place it in 52-week-low screens. Engagement is a handful of likes on each; the strongest bear-adjacent item is just inclusion in a high-risk screen, not a thesis.

sellside.consensus: Twelve retained notes, effectively all Buy: Citi raised its target to 4.6 on 2026-08-12 and repeated Buy on 2026-09-03 after the buyback was doubled to USD 100m, HSBC (4.5) and BOC (3.50) are also Buy, and Morgan Stanley is the only Equal-weight. No note in the bundle treats cash burn as thesis-breaking.

theses.name: MINISO Group Holding Ltd.
theses.one_liner: MINISO's operating margin fell from 19.24% in FY2024 to 13.84% in FY2025, H2 2026 will close 100-110 overseas stores, and HSBC cut its target 40% saying the growth thesis has broken down.
theses.thesis: The market still pays 15.15x trailing earnings and 1.80x book for MINISO on a 2027 margin-inflection promise, and the sell-side has only partly marked it down: HSBC downgraded to Hold and cut its target 40% from USD 18.10 to USD 10.80 on 2026-08-31, stating the growth thesis has broken down and cutting 2026-28 net profit estimates by 41-50%. The mechanism is margin, not demand: revenue grew 22.4% to RMB 11,499m in H1 2026 and 17.0% to RMB 5,811m in Q2, yet FY2025 operating margin fell to 13.84% from 19.24% and FY2025 net margin to 5.62% from 15.40%, with Q2 2026 net margin at -4.98% and Q4 2025 at -2.26%. The overseas engine is contracting rather than decelerating - agency stores fell a net 41 in H1 2026 with another 100-110 closures guided for H2 - while the group carries 9.4% YoY dilution and the tape is -62.6% over twelve months. The gap closes if domestic same-store growth and the IP mix fail to deliver the 2027 inflection the price embeds.
bear_points: Operating margin fell from 19.24% (FY2024) to 13.84% (FY2025) and net margin from 15.40% to 5.62%; Q2 2026 net margin was -4.98% and Q4 2025 was -2.26%, on revenue growth of 17% and 21% respectively - growth without profit.

The overseas business is contracting, not merely slowing: H1 2026 agency stores fell a net 41, another 100-110 closures are guided for H2 2026 against only 40-50 direct-store additions, and H2 overseas growth is guided to low single digits (东方财富 2026-09-14, 东吴证券 2026-09-04, 国信证券 2026-09-03).

HSBC downgraded to Hold on 2026-08-31 and cut its target 40% from USD 18.10 to USD 10.80, cutting 2026-28 net profit estimates by 41-50% and stating the growth thesis has broken down - the single most negative broker action in this batch.

Q2 2026 produced a quarterly attributable loss of RMB 292m including a RMB 597m MiniMax mark-to-market loss and RMB 142m of FX loss, and Q3 2026 operating margin is guided down 4-5pct YoY (国元国际 2026-09-01, 国信证券 2026-09-03).

Shareholders were diluted 9.4% year over year while the equity lost 62.6% over twelve months, 51.3% YTD and 19.1% in the last month (screen 'broken tape' flag). The buyback runs against a founder prepaid forward of 21.6m shares (about USD 47m) to Goldman Sachs flagged on 2026-09-22, in a filing that never uses the word sale.
risks_to_short: Domestic is genuinely strong and is the majority of revenue: H1 2026 mainland revenue +26.2% (a three-year high), same-store GMV up mid-single digits, AOV up to RMB 41.0, membership 130m (+31%), IP products at 80-90% of the mix, and the YOYO IP entering 53 countries with first-month global GMV above RMB 100m (国元国际 2026-09-01, 国联民生证券 2026-09-03, 申万宏源 2026-09-03).

UBS stayed Buy with PT USD 14 (2026-09-02) against an USD 8.98 close, the company committed to returning at least 50% of adjusted net profit, and management guides 2026 as the profit trough with a 2027 inflection - if the overseas reset annualises, the forward multiple is not demanding.

The stock is already down 62.6% in twelve months with short interest at only 2.83% of the 86.87m-share float on an USD 9.87m ADT, so borrow is easy (borrow score 90.0) and the 0.09 beta gives no index-hedge carry; the easy money in the de-rating has been made.

There is no small-cap squeeze mechanic, but there is a value bid: 0.81x sales, 1.80x book, a 50% payout commitment and explicit '2026 is the bottom' guidance is exactly the setup retail is buying into on X (@Gubloinvestor, 2026-08-28, 'all in at USD 10').
catalysts: Q3 2026 results - the print that tests the guided 4-5pct YoY operating-margin decline and whether domestic momentum offsets it.
The H2 2026 overseas store-closure programme (100-110 agency stores) and whether the direct-store additions (40-50) carry the cost.
The 2027 margin-inflection guidance: a push-out is the re-rate trigger, a confirmation is the squeeze.
The founder's prepaid forward on 21.6m shares to Goldman Sachs, flagged 2026-09-22, whose settlement mechanics the filing does not disclose.
The commitment to return at least 50% of adjusted net profit, against H1 2026 attributable profit of RMB 962m.

theses.name: Eason Technology Limited
theses.one_liner: Eason Technology runs a -52.5% gross margin with revenue compounding down 43% a year and an EV of USD 27.4m on a USD 2.47m market cap, while the only X read is a long heckling the short.
theses.thesis: DXF's economics are inverted: FY2025 gross margin -52.5%, operating margin -171.1% and net margin -90.9% on revenue of 8.60m, down 81% from 45.48m in FY2022 (three-year CAGR -42.6%), with operating cash outflow of 3.31m and the screen's heavy-dilution flag carrying the largest dilution_yoy reading in this batch at 101.9. Enterprise value of USD 27.35m against a USD 2.47m market cap puts roughly USD 24.9m of net liabilities ahead of the equity, so the ADS - each representing 60,000 ordinary shares - is a residual claim on a business that loses money per unit sold. What the tape argues about is not that arithmetic but the tape itself: the sweep's only substantive DXF item is a trader watching one short defend USD 0.65 for weeks on a sub-2m float and calling anyone heavy short 'the craziest person at the fair' (@KojiroSasaki, 2026-09-16).
bear_points: Negative gross margin: FY2025 gross margin -52.5% against +97.4% in FY2022, with operating margin -171.1% and net margin -90.9% - the business destroys value on every unit of revenue it books.
Revenue collapse: 8.60m in FY2025 versus 45.48m in FY2022, a -42.6% three-year CAGR and -11.4% YoY, with operating cash outflow of 3.31m and the screen reporting net margin -90.9%.

Leverage dwarfs the equity: EV of USD 27.35m against a USD 2.47m market cap implies roughly USD 24.9m of net liabilities, and the ADS represents 60,000 ordinary shares - the footprint of repeated reverse splits per the screen's own instrument description.

Dilution is the largest in this batch: the screen carries the heavy-dilution flag with a dilution_yoy reading of 101.9, while the tape is -89.2% over one year, -66.0% year-to-date and -98.8% over three.

Coverage is a void and there is no dilution discussion at all: AlphaEngine returns 7 documents, all 公告 (most recent 重大事件报告 2026-07-01, FY2025 annual report 2026-04-30) with no broker research, and the X sweep states plainly that DXF has no dilution or offering discussion in the window - only one tape observation and one list post.

The 60,000-ordinary-shares-per-ADS ratio means the listed line is a thin, split-adjusted wrapper: corporate actions rather than fundamentals can dominate the print, and the screen gives no float data to size against.

At a USD 2.47m market cap with USD 265,363 of average daily turnover, any positive corporate action, asset sale or reverse-split announcement produces a multiple rather than a percentage move against a short.

theses.name: Lufax Holding Ltd Class A
theses.one_liner: Lufax's revenue has fallen at a 27% three-year CAGR, FY22/23 accounts were restated down 11%/9% after an auditor change, and the HK tape only reopened on 24 Sep after 20 months.
theses.thesis: Lufax is a governance-discount equity with a shrinking book: revenue fell from RMB 80.3bn in FY2022 to RMB 31.3bn in FY2025 (-27% CAGR), TTM net loss is RMB 4.19bn, and the FY22/23 accounts were restated down 11% and 9% after the auditor change to EY (Citi, 2026-04-26), which caused Deutsche Bank to suspend coverage in January 2026 and the Hong Kong listing to stay suspended for about 20 months. The bull case is entirely balance sheet - 0.089x book and JPMorgan's 0.1x forward PB with cash at 267% of market cap, upgraded to Overweight on 28 July - so the short mechanism is that a 0.1x multiple on a restated, still loss-making book cannot re-rate while the 24% rate cap heads toward roughly 12% and the 2026 funding freeze squeezes originations. The honest caveat: with USD 1.37m of daily liquidity and a T3 tier, this is a structural observation that is very hard to hold short.
bear_points: Revenue collapse: FY2022 RMB 80.3bn to FY2025 RMB 31.3bn, a -27% three-year CAGR, with TTM net loss of RMB 4.19bn and a -16.0% TTM net margin (screen).

Restatements and an auditor change: FY22/23 net profit restated down 11%/9% to RMB 7.8bn and RMB 0.81bn and FY24 a net loss of RMB 3.9bn (Citi, 2026-04-26); Deutsche Bank suspended coverage on 2026-01-27 because audited results were repeatedly delayed and stated its prior recommendations and forecasts were no longer reliable.

Governance file: two related-party transaction investigations requiring retrospective trust consolidation and new provisions, an 8-15% FY23 net profit impact and a 2% reduction in total assets (Citi, 2025-04-24); a CRO change and a further annual-report delay (JPMorgan, 2025-10-27); and a 6-K disclosing DeCheng loans of RMB 3.84bn with RMB 1.4bn impaired, six former executives and 24 internal-control deficiencies described as remediated (@Pennyguin1, 21 Sep).

Listing risk is not closed: the 27 July HK resume deadline was missed and trading restarted on 24 Sep 2026 only after restatements, an unqualified EY opinion on FY24/25 and a Ping An irrevocable undertaking, with the exchange still able to pursue Listing Rules breaches (@Pennyguin1, 21 and 24 Sep).

Asset quality and the industry mechanism: 30-day+ delinquency was 6.1% in 1Q26 (JPMorgan, 2026-04-28) and C-M3 flow 1.1% (JPMorgan, 2025-10-27), so the reported book improves by shrinking rather than curing; X describes a 24% rate cap heading toward about 12% plus a 2026 funding freeze (@westlakecap, 21 Sep), and JPMorgan expects 3Q/4Q industry liquidity and regulatory tightening (2026-08-11).
risks_to_short: Deep value with cash: 0.089x book and JPMorgan's 0.1x 2026E PB with cash at 267% of market cap, which it called limited downside (2026-04-17) before upgrading to Overweight with PT 2.2 on 2026-08-19.
Documented improvement: 2Q26 net loss narrowed 72% YoY to RMB 201m with RMB 30m of pre-tax profit (Deutsche Bank, 2026-08-27), and new loans grew 4.6% YoY to RMB 51.1bn (H1 2026 call, 2026-08-19).

The audit and listing overhang has partly cleared: audited FY24/25 with an unqualified EY opinion, NYSE continued-listing requirements met, and the HK tape restored on 24 Sep 2026 with a Ping An irrevocable undertaking (X and the H1 transcript).

Tape and borrow: USD 1.37m ADT with a T3 restricted tier and a 'broken tape' flag, and 4.48m shares short (5.25% of float) into the first post-suspension tape is a squeeze risk if southbound or index flows arrive.
catalysts: First full post-resumption Hong Kong reporting and any index treatment
3Q26 results and the pace of the loss narrowing
Any HKEX Listing Rules action over the suspension
Further rate-cap and funding regulation into 4Q26

The honest caveat is that USD 11,325 of average daily turnover makes this close to untradeable, so the dilution is a documented fact without an expressible short.
bear_points: Placement pricing is maximally dilutive: 40,000,000 new Class A at USD 0.168, stated as 15% of the prior close and roughly 1.66x the 24,064,050 Class A then outstanding, agreed 2026-08-25 and reported in a same-day 6-K (@Pennyguin1, 2026-08-28; filing bot @NShkol92186, 2026-08-29).

It is the third capital event in five weeks: a USD 5,000,000 / 20,000,000-share placement on 2026-08-11 and a July shareholder vote authorising up to 5,000,000,000 shares precede it, on a base that has already been through a 2,000-for-1 reverse split.
Consideration is payable in crypto: USD, USDC, USDT or BTC (@Pennyguin1, 2026-08-28) - a channel that bypasses the book - and the bundle discloses no use of proceeds for any of the three placements.

The underlying business burns cash on a declining top line: FY2025 revenue 11.51m, -9.6% YoY and roughly flat over three years, with net margin -72.1%, operating cash outflow of 6.77m and free cash flow of USD -0.87m; the screen shows share count down 66.3% YoY, a reverse-split artifact rather than restraint.

Coverage is a void: AlphaEngine returns 12 documents, all 公告, including a withdrawn registration statement (撤回注册声明, 2026-05-06) and a fresh F-1 (2026-09-08), and the only substantive X item is a filing post with 0 likes, 50 views and an empty reply tree - documented but not debated.

The placement buyers are deeply in the money and have every incentive to see the stock work: crypto-funded holders at USD 0.168 against a 1.1201 close are the natural bid, and the outstanding F-1 filed 2026-09-08 exists to give them an exit.

A Hong Kong corporate-finance franchise with a positive EV gap is a real asset: EV of USD 59.96m sits below the USD 75.47m market cap and the screen gives a 17.8-year runway, so this is a dilution story, not an imminent solvency one.

theses.name: ZTO Express (Cayman), Inc. Class A
theses.one_liner: ZTO is an Alibaba supply overhang on top of a volume deceleration - the 2026 parcel guide was cut to 6-10%, August industry volume grew 2.7%, and Q2 profit leaned on a RMB 344m tax refund.
theses.thesis: Earnings are actually accelerating: Q2-26 revenue of RMB 14.55bn (+23%) and adjusted net profit of RMB 3.09bn (+50.3%) on per-parcel revenue of RMB 1.37 (+15.5%). Two things decide the next two quarters. First, supply: Alibaba sold about 25m ADS at 20.02 for roughly 500m on 21 Sep, cutting its stake to about 6%, and the ADR fell 7.2% against a 4.5% block discount, which J.P.Morgan reads as the market pricing further sales with the next tranche undisclosed. Second, volume: ZTO cut its 2026 parcel-volume guidance from 10-13% to 6-10% (Macquarie) and August industry volume grew only 2.7% yoy (J.P.Morgan). The +15.5% per-parcel pricing carrying the profit is a policy outcome from the anti-involution campaign, not a demand signal.
bear_points: Alibaba supply overhang: about 25m ADS sold at 20.02 for roughly 500m via an unregistered block on 21 Sep, taking the stake to about 6.1% per the 13D/A cited on X (J.P.Morgan says 6.3%); the ADR closed down 7.2% at 19.45 versus a 4.5% block discount, which J.P.Morgan (22 Sep) reads as the market discounting further sales.
Volume guidance was cut: 2026 parcel-growth guidance went from 10-13% to 6-10% (Macquarie, 20 Aug), Q2 volume of +6.5% missed, and August industry-wide volume rose only 2.7% yoy (J.P.Morgan, 22 Sep).

Q2 profit quality: the +50.3% adjusted net profit of RMB 3.09bn includes a RMB 344m income-tax refund, and per-parcel adjusted profit of RMB 0.29 was only +RMB 0.016 q/q once that is excluded (长江证券, 20 Aug).

Margins have already stepped down over two years: gross margin 30.5% (FY24) to 25.7% (FY25) and operating margin 26.2% to 21.9%; the current +15.5% per-parcel pricing is a policy outcome, not proof of pricing power.

The company diluted 7.1% yoy while repurchasing stock, and the buyback is the only near-term support the sell-side cites - J.P.Morgan says buybacks cushion the downside, which is a statement about the absence of a fundamental bid.
risks_to_short: Buyback cushion: 740m repurchased in H1-26, equal to 52% of 2025 adjusted net profit, with a 1.5bn programme that still had about 1.34bn remaining (国盛证券, 21 Aug); J.P.Morgan explicitly cites buybacks as downside support.

theses.name: Noah Holdings Ltd. Class A
theses.one_liner: Noah is a net-cash wealth manager with an EV of USD 36m on a USD 564m market cap and a 13-15% dividend yield; the Q2 print was margin-up, so it is not a usable short.
theses.thesis: The screen offers almost nothing to short here - the only flag is 'thin'. TTM net income is RMB 586m on revenue of RMB 2.65bn (+6.0%), TTM free cash flow is RMB 821m (a 20.5% FCF yield), the shares trade at 0.41x book and 6.6x earnings, and an EV of USD 36m against a USD 564m market cap means roughly 94% of the equity is net cash. The only bear mechanism that survives is a discount-persistence argument, not an earnings one: the single structured NOAH bear post on X calls it a 'jurisdictional value trap' (VIE structure, hard-to-repatriate cash, net income down 61% from the 2021 peak), and J.P. Morgan keeps Neutral on regulatory uncertainty over mainland clients investing offshore. Q2 2026 actually beat on cost cuts and one-off performance fees, with core distribution revenue weak - that is a reason the discount persists, not a catalyst to widen it, which is why the screen's weakness component is only 18.8/100.
bear_points: The top line is stagnant: TTM revenue growth of +6.0% but a three-year CAGR of -6.95%, with Q2 2026 net revenue of RMB 620m, -2% YoY and -1% QoQ (中金公司 2026-08-27).
The Q2 profit beat was non-core: J.P. Morgan (2026-08-26) attributes it to performance fees up 501% YoY and RMB 55m of affiliate income, while core wealth-management product sales fell 25% QoQ.

Distribution is shrinking from both sides: Q2 2026 fundraising fee income RMB 90m, -44% YoY and -24% QoQ (insurance commissions the main drag), management fee income RMB 360m, -11% YoY, and AUM RMB 140.9bn, -3% YoY, with domestic private-equity products still exiting.

Governance/discount mechanism: the only structured bear post on X (29 Aug 2026) frames NOAH as a 'jurisdictional value trap' - VIE structure, cash that is hard to repatriate, and net income down 61% from the 2021 peak - and notes the ~6x P/E is the discount, not the mispricing.

Regulatory overhang on the only growing channel: J.P. Morgan expects additional H2 2026 operating pressure from restrictions on mainland clients investing overseas, the segment (RMB 8.7bn of Q2 fundraising, +9% QoQ) that offset a 45% QoQ collapse in domestic fundraising.
risks_to_short: Mechanically unfavourable: an EV of USD 36m on a USD 564m market cap means about 94% of the equity is backed by net cash, on top of 0.41x book and a 13-15% dividend yield. There is very little downside left to harvest.

Citi is Buy with a USD 11.5 target (2026-09-02), cutting the target but explicitly citing the ~15% 2026 dividend yield as share-price support, and 中金公司 called Q2 2026 above expectations. J.P. Morgan and UBS are Neutral, not bearish.

The company has been non-GAAP profitable for 62 consecutive quarters and cut costs 13.7% YoY in Q2 2026 to a 34.8% operating margin; a fee-normalisation short is fighting both cost discipline and a board that has proposed distributing 100% of 2025 non-GAAP net income.
Short interest is only 1.95% of float (borrow score 90/100), so there is no crowded-short unwind to help, and ADT of USD 0.86m makes the constraint exit liquidity rather than borrow availability.
